pages.en:
November 9, 1939. Morning Translation

Tan Pao-nyi and others surreptitiously returned to Shanghai from Hongkong in June and went into hiding in the French Concession, but they changed their abodes frequently while awaiting for a chance to assassinate Wang Ching-wei who was residing on Yu Yuen Road. However, owing to the strict precautionary measures adopted, they had no opportunity. Subsequently they were apprehended as they were about to return to Hongkong.

Prisoners Are Converted To National Salvation Through Peace : Plans of Their Movement Divulged

During the 5 months following their arrest on June 29, the two prisoners steadfastly refused to make any statement and denied having participated in any crime. The Japanese Gendarmerie requested a certain high pro-Japanese official to visit the two prisoners and to explain away their anti-Japanese spirit, thereby converting them to the movement of national salvation through peace. As a result of the efforts of this high pro-Japanese official, the two men began to understand the true significance of this movement and later they made their confessions divulging their movements and plans to assassinate Wang Ching-wei.

Antecedents of the two prisoners

Ping Foh-chang, age 24, native of Funing, Kiangsu, formerly lived in Soong Ching Li (松山里) off Tsepoo Road. At the age of 18 he discontinued his studies in a certain middle school and went to work as an apprentice with a certain watch-maker's shop on Railway Station Road (車站路) in Nantao. Two years later he was appointed an inspector in Hankow but returned to Shanghai in June, 1937. On the outbreak of the Sino-Japanese hostilities in August, he became a squad chief of the Kiangsu-Chekiang Movement Corps organized by Tsu Hsueh-van (朱學範) in Nanking. After the fall of Nanking in November, he came to Shanghai and lived in the French Concession and joined the Military Affairs Commission. On the instructions of Li Shang-bah (李尚白), he underwent three months' strict training in Hupeh. He had intended to enter the Military Academy in Changsha, but the school could not resume its classes because of the bombing activities of Japanese planes. In September, 1938, he was instructed by Li Shang-bah to become, together with Chiang Soo (蔣蘇) and others, an executive member of the anti-Japanese terrorists. He then came to Shanghai to undertake his new work under Yeu Ho-ching.

Tan Pao-nyi, age 23, is a native of Sunikiang. After his graduation from the Chung Hwa Vocational School (中華職業學校), Nantao, in 1937, he worked as an apprentice surveyor with the Han-Yeh-Ping Company (漢冶萍公司) in Hengyang (衡陽), Hunan. On the outbreak of the Sino-Japanese hostilities, he joined the Chinese army and underwent special military training. He came to Shanghai in January this year and was attached to the Field Section of the Bureau of Investigation and Statistics of the Military Affairs Commission.
pages.zh:
1939年11月9日。晨间译件

谭保毅等人于六月从香港潜回上海，藏匿于法租界，但在等待刺杀居住于愚园路的汪精卫的机会期间，他们频繁更换住所。然而，由于采取了严密的预防措施，他们未能找到下手的机会。随后，他们在准备返回香港时被逮捕。

囚犯转而拥护“和平救国”：其运动计划被 divulged（泄露）

在6月29日被捕后的5个月内，两名囚犯坚决拒绝做任何陈述，并否认参与任何犯罪活动。日本宪兵队请求某位亲日高官探访这两名囚犯，以化解他们的反日情绪，从而将他们转化为“和平救国”运动的拥护者。在这位亲日高官的努力下，两人开始理解该运动的真正意义，随后他们做出供认，泄露了他们的行动以及刺杀汪精卫的计划。

两名囚犯的背景

平福昌（Ping Foh-chang），24岁，江苏阜宁人，此前居住在乍浦路松山里。18岁时，他从某中学辍学，前往南市车站路的一家钟表店当学徒。两年后，他被任命为汉口的督察，但于1937年6月返回上海。8月中日敌对行动爆发后，他成为朱学范在南京组织的苏浙行动委员会的一名班长。11月南京沦陷后，他来到上海，居住在法租界，并加入了军事委员会。根据李尚白的指示，他在湖北接受了三个月的严格训练。他原本打算进入长沙的军校，但由于日军飞机的轰炸活动，学校无法复课。1938年9月，他奉李尚白之命，与蒋苏等人一起成为抗日恐怖分子的执行成员。随后他来到上海，在叶火青（Yeu Ho-ching，音译）手下开展新工作。

谭保毅，23岁，孙家江（Sunikiang，音译）人。1937年从南市中华职业学校毕业后，他在湖南衡阳的汉冶萍公司担任见习测量员。中日敌对行动爆发后，他加入中国军队并接受了特种军事训练。今年一月他来到上海，隶属于军事委员会调查统计局外勤组。

Shan-Ken-Ko
No. 1235.

Japanese Gendarmerie,
Shanghai.

November 10, 1939.

Major K.H.Bourne,
Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council.

Sir,

With reference to the assassination of late
Cheng Lok (陳籙), former Minister for Foreign Affairs
of the Reformed Government, perpetrated at 622/25 Yu Yuen
Road on February 19, 1939, I am given to understand that
the pistols which were discarded by assassins after the

commission of the assassination are in the custody of
the Shanghai Municipal Police.

I, therefore, take the pleasure to request you
for the handing over into our custody at your earliest
convenience of the pistols referred to, as the evidence
against Ping Foo Chang (平福昌) and Dan Pan Yee
(譚保毅) who were handed over to us permanently
on November 8th, 1939.

I am, Sir,
Very truly yours,

Chopped: S.Hase.
Provost Marshal.

                     February 19th.,   39.
L.

ASSASSINATION OF REFORMED GOVERNMENT OFFICIAL.

At 7.15p.m. 19/2/39, a telephone call was
received at this station from C.C.R., reporting a murder
at 668/25 Yu Yuen Road.

A party of Police under S.I. Bozman at once
attended, and Officer i/c and Sen. Det. followed.

The following was ascertained:-

At about 7p.m. 19/2/39, a gang of assassins,
about 15 in number, all believed to be armed, and
speaking Northern dialect, went to the home of Mr.
Tcheng Loh ( 陳籙 ), Foreign Minister of the Reformed
Government, and a former Ambassador to France, 668/25
Yu Yuen Road. After holding up the watchman on the
front gate, and taking away his pistol, the gang went
to the back door of the house. Seven or eight members
of the gang then went into the house, proceeded to the
dining room on the ground floor which was occupied by
Mr. Tcheng Loh, several members of his family and two
guests, and fired several shots at Mr. Tcheng Loh as he
was sitting on a sofa. One shot passed through his
head, and another through his right leg.

The gang remained on the premises for 3 or 4
minutes, saying as they left, "All is finished."
Inmates of the house at once called a ricksha.

L.

维新政府官员遇刺案。

1939年2月19日晚上7时15分，本站接到中央无线电室（C.C.R.）的电话，报告愚园路668/25号发生谋杀案。

由副督察博兹曼（Bozman）率领的一队警察立即赶赴现场，主管警官及高级侦探随后赶到。

查明情况如下：

1939年2月19日晚上7点左右，一伙约15人的刺客，据信均持有武器，讲北方方言，前往维新政府外交部长、前驻法国大使陈洛（Tcheng Loh）先生位于愚园路668/25号的家中。在制服前门的看守并夺走其手枪后，这伙人走向房屋后门。随后，七八名团伙成员进入屋内，前往一楼的餐厅，陈洛先生、他的几位家庭成员和两名客人正在那里用餐。当陈洛先生坐在沙发上时，他们向他开了几枪。一颗子弹穿过他的头部，另一颗穿过他的右腿。

这伙人在现场停留了3或4分钟，离开时说：“一切都结束了。”屋内的人立即叫了一辆黄包车。

档案
R
2月27日

ambulance, and Mr. Tsheng Loh was removed to the Red

dead."

It was later noticed that two armed attendants
attached to Mr. Tsheng Loh's household, were missing,
and had either been abducted, or had voluntarily left
with the gang.

D.C. (Crime), and D.D.O. "B" Division attended,
together with detectives from C.I., and the following
details were brought to light:-

Mr. Tsheng Loh has been Foreign Minister of the
Reformed Government for about one year. He spent most
of his time at Nanking and in the northern provinces.
He came to Shanghai from Nanking, and arrived at the
North Station at 3p.m. 14/2/39, reaching his home about
one hour later. Mr. Tsheng travelled with his armed
attendant Tan Kee Ming (趙玉明), from Nanking, and
was met at the North Station by his private m/car
licence No. 6454, driven by his chauffeur Wong Rong
Kwei (黃永貴), permit No. C.M.P. 19688. Armed
attendant Tsang Shu Yuen (張樹穩), permit No. A1366
was waiting in the car together with a Miss Ma Wei
(馬慧), a relation of Mr. Tsheng Loh, and also
employed as a clerk by the Reformed Government.

和一辆救护车，陈洛（Tsheng Loh）先生被送往红十字会医院，经认证：“送院时已死亡”。

后来注意到，陈洛（Tsheng Loh）先生家中的两名武装随从失踪，要么是被绑架，要么是自愿随那伙人离开。

罪案科副总监和“B”区副总监办公室人员到场，连同中央巡捕房的侦探，查明了以下细节：

陈洛（Tsheng Loh）先生担任维新政府外交部长约一年。他大部分时间在南京和北方省份度过。他于1939年2月14日下午3点从南京抵达上海北站，约一小时后到家。陈洛先生与他的武装随从赵玉明（Tan Kee Ming，音译注：原文英文名为Tan，中文注音为赵，此处依原文翻译并保留中文名）从南京同行，并在北站由他的私人轿车（执照号6454）接回，司机为黄永贵（Wong Rong Kwei），许可证号C.M.P. 19688。武装随从张树稳（Tsang Shu Yuen），许可证号A1366，当时正与陈洛先生的亲属马慧（Ma Wei）小姐一起在车内等候，马慧小姐也在维新政府担任职员。

载有陆鼎和先生（Mr. Teheng Loh）、甘薇小姐（Miss Kan Wei）、两名武装随从赵玉廷（Zau Yue Ding）和张树稳（Tsang Shu Wuen），以及司机黄永贵（Wong Yoeng Kwei）的汽车，随后驶至北四川路与巨邦路（Jubang Road）转角处，与由陆鼎和先生之子陆裕泰先生（Mr. Teheng Yu Tae）驾驶、车牌号为 11768 的机动车相遇，车上有一名名为郝鹏（Hoh Pang）(音译) 的保镖。两车随即前往百老汇大厦，除司机黄永贵外，所有人均前往四楼 17 号公寓。（该公寓是维新政府外交部的临时办公室，也是陆鼎和先生访沪期间的住所。十分钟后，同一批人再次出来，乘车前往陆鼎和先生位于愚园路 664/25 号的寓所。

自抵达寓所以来，陆鼎和先生未再离开该处。在此期间，多位亲友曾亲自登门拜访。

该寓所由 6 名更夫和 3 名保镖守卫，名单如下：-

(1) 宋海林 (Soong Hai King)，30 岁，上海人，未婚，居住于愚园路 664/25 号。
(2) 赵贵春 (Sau Hsui Tsang)，37 岁，上海人，已婚，居住于愚园路 664/25 号。

At about 7p.m. 16/2/39, Watchman Soong Hai Ling
(宋海林), armed with a small revolver, (not licensed)
was on duty at the watchman's hut at the front gate,
when he saw a number of Chinese, mostly wearing long
gowns, approach the house both from the south and the
north. There appeared to be about 15 men in all, and
one of them, speaking northern dialect, came to him in
the hut, and asked if he was armed. Before he had
time to answer, he was set upon by the gang, all of
whom appeared to be armed, and his pistol was taken
away from him. He was then taken to the back door and
held there whilst about 7 or 8 of the gang went into
the house. A few moments later, he heard the report

1939 年 2 月 16 日晚 7 时许，更夫宋海林（宋海林）持有一把小型左轮手枪（无执照），正在前门岗亭执勤，此时他看见一群中国人，大多身穿长衫，从南北两个方向朝寓所走来。总人数约为 15 人，其中一人操北方方言，走到岗亭问他是否携带武器。他还没来得及回答，便遭到这伙人的袭击，这些人似乎都持有武器，他的手枪被夺走。随后他被带至后门并在那里被看守，与此同时，约 7 或 8 名匪徒进入屋内。片刻之后，他听到

pages.en:
Misc. No. 69/39.

1/sheet 5.

of 7 or 8 shots, and about three minutes later the
assassins came out, and noticed that in their company
were Hoh Pang (郝鹏) and Lau Yue Bing (赵玉廷).
Whether these two men came out of the house of their
own accord, or were forced out by the assassins, he
cannot say. He was then released, and went into the
house, seeing his master lying on the floor near the
sofa in the dining room, with blood coming from his head.
Inmates of the house then notified the Police
and called a doctor and an ambulance.
When Police arrived at the scene, Mr. Tcheng Loh
had already been removed by the ambulance.
An examination of the drawing room revealed:-
That portion of the sofa on which Mr. Tcheng
Loh had been reclining, was covered with blood and the
upholstery had been penetrated by a number of bullets
which had lodged in the wall at the back of the sofa.
Two sheets of crumpled paper bearing Chinese characters
were found on the sofa. These were left by the
assassins. Translated they read as follows:-
"Resistance will result in victory.
Construction of the country will succeed.
Long live General Chiang. Long live the
Republic of China. Independence unlimited.
Keep Chinese property by own."

七八声枪响，大约三分钟后，刺客们走了出来，他注意到郝鹏（郝鹏）和赵玉廷（Lau Yue Bing）(注：此处原文英文名与前文 Ian Yee Ding 对应中文名赵玉廷不一致，依原文译出) 也在他们中间。这两人是自愿走出屋子，还是被刺客强迫带出，他无法确定。随后他被释放，进入屋内，看见主人躺在餐厅沙发附近的地板上，头部流血。
屋内人员随即通知警方，并呼叫医生和救护车。
警方到达现场时，陆鼎和先生（Mr. Tcheng Loh）已被救护车送走。
对客厅的检查显示：-
陆鼎和先生当时倚靠的那部分沙发上沾满血迹，软垫被数颗子弹穿透，子弹嵌在沙发后面的墙壁里。
沙发上发现两张写有汉字的皱纸。这是刺客留下的。翻译如下：
“抵抗必获胜利。
建国事业必将成功。
蒋将军万岁。中华民国万岁。独立无疆。
保持中国财产归中国人所有。”

Three .32 bullet cases, one .32 bullet, one .32

At the time of the shooting, Seong Hai Ling was
the only watchman on duty, the other five being in the
upper part of the house.

One bodyguard Moh Pang was on duty at the time.
The bodyguard Lau Yue Ding, although not on duty, was
in the downstairs part of the house. It is believed
that only Moh Pang was armed. The remaining bodyguard
Tsang Chu Wuen was upstairs.

Mauser pistol No. 104562 and 27 rounds in
possession of Tang Poh Tsung, Mauser pistol No. 28164
and 8) round, in possession of Lau Kwai Tsung, and
Browning pistol Licence No. T 4699, two magazines and 15
rounds, in possession of Tsang Chu Wuen, were taken away

The body of Mr. Tcheong has been taken to the
mortuary at the Kat Owan Hospital.

两张纸上均印有圆圈内的数字 11 标记，附后。

在房间内发现了三枚 .32 口径弹壳、一枚 .32 口径子弹、一发 .32 口径整装子弹和一枚 .38 口径左轮手枪子弹。这些物证已移交给军械鉴定科 Ewins 副督察进行检查。（其口头报告称，该枚 .38 口径左轮手枪子弹系由 1939 年 2 月 6 日刺杀华道敦（Datoon Wo）( 華 ) 一案中所使用的手枪射出。 FIR 第 197/39 号 (Ch.Mt.)）

枪击发生时，只有更夫宋海林（Seong Hai Ling）在执勤，其他五名更夫均在房屋上层。

当时有一名保镖郝鹏（Moh Pang）(注：此处原文拼写与前文 Hoh Pang 略有不同，依上下文应为同一人) 在执勤。另一名保镖赵玉廷（Lau Yue Ding）虽未在执勤，但在房屋楼下。据信只有郝鹏携带武器。其余保镖张树稳（Tsang Chu Wuen）在楼上。

警方收缴了汤伯宗（Tang Poh Tsung）持有的毛瑟手枪 No. 104562 及 27 发子弹、刘桂宗（Lau Kwai Tsung）持有的毛瑟手枪 No. 28164 及 8) 发子弹（原文如此），以及张树稳（Tsang Chu Wuen）持有的勃朗宁手枪（执照号 T 4699）、两个弹匣和 15 发子弹，并移交给 Ewins 副督察进行检查。

陆先生（Mr. Tcheong）的遗体已被送往戈登路医院（Kat Owan Hospital）的停尸房。

ASSASSINATION OF REFORMED GOVERNMENT OFFICIAL.

At 7.15p.m. 19/2/39, a telephone call was
received at this station from C.C.R., reporting a murder
at 668/25 Yu Yuen Road.

A party of Police under S.I. Beeman at once
attended, and Officer i/c and Sen. Det. followed.

The following was ascertained:-

At about 7p.m. 19/2/39, a gang of assassins,
about 15 in number, all believed to be armed, and
speaking Northern dialect, went to the home of Mr.
Tcheng Loh ( 陳籙 ), Foreign Minister of the Reformed
Government, and a former Ambassador to France, 668/25
Yu Yuen Road. After holding up the watchman on the
front gate, and taking away his pistol, the gang went
to the back door of the house. Seven or eight members
of the gang then went into the house, proceeded to the
drawing room on the ground floor which was occupied by
Mr. Tcheng Loh, several members of his family and two
guests, and fired several shots at Mr. Tcheng Loh as he
was sitting on a sofa. One shot passed through his
head, and another through his right leg.

The gang remained on the premises for 3 or 4
minutes, saying as they left, "All is finished."
Members of the household at once called a S.P.B.

维新政府官员遇刺案。

1939 年 2 月 19 日晚 7:15，本分局接到中央无线电室（C.C.R.）的电话，报告愚园路 668/25 号发生谋杀案。

由高级督察比曼（S.I. Beeman）率领的一队警察立即前往，辖区负责人和高级侦缉员随后赶到。

查明情况如下：-

1939 年 2 月 19 日晚 7 时许，一伙约 15 人的刺客，据信均持有武器，操北方方言，前往维新政府外交部长、前驻法国大使陈籙先生（Mr. Tcheng Loh）( 陳籙 ) 位于愚园路 668/25 号的寓所。在制服前门更夫并夺走其手枪后，这伙人前往房屋后门。随后，七到八名匪徒进入屋内，前往一楼客厅，陈籙先生、其数名家庭成员及两名客人当时正在此处，匪徒向坐在沙发上的陈籙先生开了数枪。一枪穿过其头部，另一枪穿过其右腿。

匪徒在屋内停留了 3 或 4 分钟，离开时说：“一切都结束了。”
住户立即呼叫了特别支部（S.P.B.）

（印章：上海公共租界警务处特别支部 39 年 2 月 20 日）

ambulance, and Mr. Tsheng Loh was removed to the Red
Cross Hospital, where he was certified:- "Brought in
dead."

It was later noticed that two armed attendants
attached to Mr. Tsheng Loh's household, were missing,
and had either been abducted, or had voluntarily left
with the gang.

D.C. (Crime), and D.D.O. "B" Division attended,
together with detectives from C.I., and the following
details were brought to light:-

Mr. Tsheng Loh has been Foreign Minister of the
Reformed Government for about one year. He spent most
of his time at Nanking and in the northern provinces.
He came to Shanghai from Nanking, and arrived at the
North Station at 3p.m. 18/2/39, reaching his home about
one hour later. Mr. Tsheng travelled with his armed
attendant Sun Yue Ding ( 趙 王 近 ), from Nanking, and
was met at the North Station by his private motor
Licence No. 4486, driven by his chauffeur Wong Yeung
Kwei ( 黃 永 貴 ), permit No. C.M.P.-3050. Armed
attendant Tsang Shu Yi ( 張 樹 德 ), permit No. A135
was waiting in the car together with a Miss Ma Wei
( 世 慧 ), a relative of Mr. Tsheng Loh, and also
employed as a clerk by the Reformed Government.
pages.zh:
杂项档案第 69/39 号。

1/第 2 页。

救护车，陈籙先生（Mr. Tsheng Loh）被送往红十字会医院，经确认：“送院时已死亡。”

随后注意到，陈籙先生家中的两名武装随从失踪，要么是被绑架，要么是自愿随匪徒离开。

刑事科助理总监和“B”区副总监到场，连同情报科侦缉员，查明了以下细节：-

陈籙先生担任维新政府外交部长约一年。他大部分时间在南京和北方省份度过。他从南京来到上海，于 1939 年 2 月 18 日下午 3 点抵达北站，约一小时后到家。陈先生与其武装随从孙玉廷（Sun Yue Ding）( 趙 王 近 )(注：原文拼音 Sun Yue Ding 与中文注音 趙王近 不符，依要求保留原文并标注中文) 一同从南京出发，其私人汽车（车牌号 4486）由司机黄永贵（Wong Yeung Kwei）( 黃 永 貴 ) 驾驶，许可证号 C.M.P.-3050，在北站接驾。武装随从张树德（Tsang Shu Yi）( 張 樹 德 )，许可证号 A135，与陈先生的亲戚马薇小姐（Miss Ma Wei）( 世 慧 ) 一同在车内等候，马薇小姐也在维新政府任职文员。

The car, containing Mr. Tsheng Leh, Miss Kan Wei,
the two armed attendants Zau Yue Ding and Tsang Shu Vuen,
and the chauffeur Wong Yoong Kwei, then drove to the

(      ). Both cars then proceeded to Broadway
Mansions, and all, with the exception of the chauffeur
Wong Yoong Kwei, went to flat No.17 on the 4th. floor.
(This flat is the temporary office of the Foreign Affair
Office of the Reformed Government, and also used by Mr.
Tsheng Leh as living quarters during his visits to
Shanghai. The same party came out again ten minutes
later, and drove to Mr. Tsheng Leh's home 668/2) Yu Yuen
Road.

Since his arrival at his home, Mr. Tsheng Leh
had not left the premises. During this time, a number
of friends and relations have paid several calls to the
house.

The house has been guarded by 6 watchmen and 3
bodyguards, as follows:-

Watchmen:-

(1) Soong Hai Ling ( 宋海林 ), 29, Kiangsu,
single, residing at 668/25 Yu Yuen Road.
(2) Zan Hual Youg ( 赵华友 ), 30, Kiangsu,
married, residing at 668/25 Yu Yuen Road.

载有陈籙先生（Mr. Tsheng Leh）、甘薇小姐（Miss Kan Wei）、两名武装随从赵玉廷（Zau Yue Ding）和张树稳（Tsang Shu Vuen），以及司机黄永贵（Wong Yoong Kwei）的汽车，随后驶至北四川路与巨洪路（Juhung Road）转角处，与由陈籙先生之子陈裕陶先生（Mr. Tsheng Yu Tao）(  ) 驾驶、车牌号为 11768 的机动车相遇，车上有一名名为郝鹏（Hoh Pang）(      ) 的保镖。两车随即前往百老汇大厦，除司机黄永贵外，所有人均前往四楼 17 号公寓。（该公寓是维新政府外交部的临时办公室，也是陈籙先生访沪期间的住所。十分钟后，同一批人再次出来，乘车前往陈籙先生位于愚园路 668/2) 号的寓所。(注：原文地址数字残缺)

自抵达寓所以来，陈籙先生未再离开该处。在此期间，多位亲友曾多次登门拜访。

该寓所由 6 名更夫和 3 名保镖守卫，名单如下：-

更夫：-

At about 7p.m. 18/2/39, Watchman Seong Hai Ling
(宋海林), armed with a small revolver, (not licensed)
was on duty at the watchman's hut at the front gate,
when he saw a number of Chinese, mostly wearing long
gowns, approach the house both from the south and the
north. There appeared to be about 15 men in all, and
one of them, speaking northern dialect, came to him in
the hut, and asked if he was armed. Before he had
time to answer, he was set upon by the gang, all of
whom appeared to be armed, and his pistol was taken
away from him. He was then taken to the back door and
held there whilst about 7 or 8 of the gang went into
the house. A few moments later, he heard the report

1939年2月18日晚7时许，巡夜员宋海林持有一把小型左轮手枪（无执照），正在前门岗亭执勤，此时他看见一群中国人，大多身穿长衫，从南面和北面两个方向朝该住宅走来。总共约有15人，其中一人操北方方言，走到岗亭问他是否携带武器。他还没来得及回答，就遭到这伙人的袭击，这些人似乎都携带武器，他的手枪被夺走。随后他被带到后门并在那里被看守，与此同时，约7或8名歹徒进入屋内。片刻之后，他听到

pages.en:
Misc. No. 69/38.

1/sheet 5.

of 7 or 8 shots, and about three minutes later the
assassins came out, and noticed that in their company
were Hoh Pang (郝鹏) and Tau Yue Ding (趙玉廷).
Whether these two men came out of the house of their
own accord, or were forced out by the assassins, he
cannot say. He was then released, and went into the
house, seeing his master lying on the floor near the
sofa in the dining room, with blood coming from his head.
Inmates of the house then notified the Police
and called a doctor and an ambulance.
When Police arrived at the scene, Mr. Tsheng Loh
had already been removed by the ambulance.
An examination of the drawing room revealed:-
That portion of the sofa on which Mr. Tsheng
Loh had been reclining, was covered with blood and the
upholstery had been penetrated by a number of bullets
which had lodged in the wall at the back of the sofa.
Two sheets of crumpled paper bearing Chinese characters
were found on the sofa. These were left by the
assassins. Translated they read as follows:-
"Resistance will result in victory.
Construction of the country will succeed.
Long live General Chiang, Long live the
Republic of China. Exterminate traitors.
Keep Chinese property for ever."
pages.zh:
杂项档案第 69/38 号。

1/第5页。

七八声枪响，大约三分钟后，刺客们走了出来，他注意到郝鹏和赵玉廷也在他们中间。至于这两人是自行走出还是被刺客强迫走出，他无法确定。随后他被释放，进入屋内，看见他的主人躺在餐厅沙发附近的地板上，头部流血。屋内人员随即通知警方，并叫来医生和救护车。
警方到达现场时，程洛先生已被救护车送走。
对客厅的检查显示：-
程洛先生当时倚靠的那部分沙发上满是血迹，软垫被多发子弹穿透，子弹嵌在沙发后面的墙壁里。
在沙发上发现两张写有汉字的皱纸。这些是刺客留下的。翻译如下：
“抵抗必获胜利。
建国事业必将成功。
蒋将军万岁，中华民国万岁。铲除汉奸。
永保中国财产。”

1/sheet 6.

Both sheets bear the mark 11 in a circle,
and are attached herewith.

Three .32 bullet cases, one .32 bullet, one .38
round, and one .38 revolver bullet were found in the
room. These were handed over to D.S.I. Swine, Arms
Identification Section for examination. (Verbal report
from him states that the .38 revolver bullet was fired
from the pistol used in the assassination of Tsien Wo
(錢華) on 4/2/39. Y.I.R. No. 197/39(Ch.Mt.)

At the time of the shooting, Leong Hui Ling was
the only watchman on duty, the other five being in the
upper part of the house.

One bodyguard Mah Pang was on duty at the time.
The bodyguard Lau Yee Ding, although not on duty, was
in the downstairs part of the house. It is believed
that only Mah Pang was armed. The remaining bodyguard
Tung Shu Wen was upstairs.

Mauser pistol No. 106845 and 27 rounds in
possession of Tung Shu Tsung, Mauser pistol No. 55166
and 24 rounds, in possession of Lau Hsui Tsung, and
Browning pistol licence No. T 6697, two magazines and 15
rounds, in possession of Tung Shu Wen, were taken away
by Police, and handed to D.S.I. Swine for examination.

The body of Mr. Tsung Ish is still lying in the
mortuary at the Red Cross Hospital.

杂项档案第 69/39 号。

1/第6页。

两张纸上均印有圆圈内的数字11标记，附后。

在房间内发现三枚.32口径弹壳、一枚.32口径子弹、一发.38口径子弹和一枚.38口径左轮手枪子弹。这些物品已移交武器识别科警司 Swine 进行检查。（其口头报告称，该枚.38口径左轮手枪子弹系由1939年2月4日刺杀钱华一案中所使用的手枪射出。青年调查处档案第 197/39 号（华捕队））

枪击发生时，梁惠玲是唯一在岗的巡夜员，其他五人在房屋上层。

当时有一名保镖马鹏在岗执勤。保镖刘玉廷虽未在岗，但在房屋下层。据信只有马鹏携带武器。其余保镖董树文在楼上。

警方收缴了董树宗持有的毛瑟手枪第106845号及27发子弹、刘水宗持有的毛瑟手枪第55166号及24发子弹，以及董树文持有的勃朗宁手枪执照第 T 6697 号、两个弹匣和15发子弹，并移交警司 Swine 进行检查。

钟石先生的遗体仍停放在红十字会医院的太平间内。

)/sheet 7.

The watchmen and bodyguards were brought to this
station for the purpose of the above enquiries, and were
allowed to go at 2a.m. 20/2/39.

Mr. T.H. Ling (林君立), son-in-law of Mr.
Tcheng Loh, who was at the house at the time of the
shooting, made mention that the chauffeur Wong Yeong Kwei
had been missing from the house during the afternoon.
However, he came back at 7.45p.m. 19/2/39, and after
questioning, his bona fides appeared to be in order. He
was allowed to go at 2a.m. 20/2/39.

Two guests who were present at the time of the
shooting, were requested to come to this station. They
assisted in verifying certain facts, and at their urgent
request, their names have been precluded from this report.

At about 9.30p.m. Mr. Gilbert, D.C. (Crime)
instructed C.I. Perkins officer i/c B'Well District to
inform Japanese Military Police upon their arrival at
B'Well Station that the premises in which deceased was
assassinated are not under the jurisdiction of the S.M.C.
These instructions were given to Inspector Yamaguchi by
Mr. Groom, D.D.O. "B", in the presence of C.I. Perkins
when Inspector Yamaguchi was on the telephone in the
Japanese Military Police notifying them of the affair.

At 11.30p.m. 19/2/39, Inspector Yamaguchi came
into the Charge Room and reported to the Sergeant on

巡夜员和保镖被带至本分局以进行上述问询，并于1939年2月20日凌晨2时被允许离开。

程洛的女婿林君立先生，枪击发生时正在屋内，提及司机黄荣贵下午曾不在屋内。然而，他于1939年2月19日晚7点45分返回，经讯问后，其身份看似无误。他于1939年2月20日凌晨2时被允许离开。

枪击发生时在场的两名客人被要求来到本分局。他们协助核实了某些事实，并经其强烈请求，本报告隐去了他们的姓名。

晚上9点30分左右，刑事科副总监 Gilbert 指示静安寺区负责警官 Perkins 警督，在日本宪兵抵达静安寺分局时告知他们，死者遇刺的房产不在工部局管辖范围内。当山口警督通过电话向日本宪兵通报此事时，“B”区副警务总监 Groom 先生在 Perkins 警督面前向山口警督下达了这些指令。

1939年2月19日晚11点30分，山口警督进入值班室并向值班警司 Burt 报告，

pages.en:
Mss. No. 82/12.
1/sheet 8.

duty P.S. Burt that the Japanese Military Police under
Sergeant Major Shide, 94 Jessfield Road had attended the
scene of the assassination and had departed.
This information was conveyed to Officer i/c
District who asked Inspector Yamaguchi if he had informed
the Japanese Military Police that the premises in ques-
tion were not under the jurisdiction of the S.M.C. He
replied that he had not done so. C.I. Perkins then
instructed him to communicate with the Japanese Military
Police and inform them that the house in which the
premises is situated is not patrolled by the S.M.P. as
it is not under the jurisdiction of the S.M.C. and to
request them to arrange for a relief of the S.M.P.
guard consisting of one foreign sergeant and four
C.P.C.s. In reply Inspector Yamaguchi stated that
he was informed by the Japanese Military Police that
they were unable to communicate with a superior officer
as there were none available with whom they could get
in touch with.
The Officer i/c District notified Capt. Smythe,
D.C. Division; accordingly, who instructed him to inform
Inspector Yamaguchi to do his best to inform a respons-
ible officer of Japanese Military Police that as the
premises were not under the jurisdiction of the S.M.C.

驻极司菲尔路94号的下士 Shide 率领的日本宪兵已抵达刺杀现场并离去。
此信息已传达给区负责警官，后者询问山口警督是否已告知日本宪兵，涉案房产不在工部局管辖范围内。他回答说没有这样做。随后 Perkins 警督指示他与日本宪兵联系，告知他们该房屋所在处不由上海公共租界工部局警务处巡逻，因为该处不在工部局管辖范围内，并请他们安排替换由一名外籍警佐和四名华捕组成的工部局警务处警卫。作为回应，山口警督称，日本宪兵告知他，由于无法联系到上级军官，故无法向上级汇报。
区负责警官据此通知分区副总监 Smythe 上尉，后者指示他告知山口警督，尽力通知日本宪兵的一名负责军官，鉴于该房产不在工部局管辖范围内，

The three arrests, namely;
1, Zee Ts Au (徐志浩).
2, Yue Piau Liang (俞標良).
3, Tsu Kah King (朱支敬).

have no previous records.

Statements (copies attached) have been taken
from them.

Zee Ts Au (statement 1) admits he formerly
served in the Chinese Nationalist Army and although fi
finishing with the army became connected with the
Chinese National Salvation Corps and, on February 19,
1939 he acted as an armed look-out at the murder of
Chen Loh (陳洛) on Yu Yuen Road.

Yue Piau Liang (statement 2) denies being in
anyway concerned in anti-Japanese activities. He is
not implicated by the 1st arrest.

Tsu Kah King (statement 3) likewise maintains
that he has not been connected with anti-Japanese
activities. He is not implicated in any way by the
1st named.

addressed to the Commissioner of Police by S. Hurn,

pages.en:
Tso Ts Au (徐志浩)
Chinghua, Chekiang                      D.S.I. Wo Chen No
                                         translated
Col, C.B.H...       14.12.39             XXXXXX      Clerk Hsia

My name is Tso Ts Au (徐志浩), alias Tso Foh Ling
(徐福林), alias Wong Ts 'ing (王正明), aged 36, native
of Chinghua, Chekiang, Single, H.F.A.

At the age of 16 I went to Kwangtung to join the
Training Depot (教導團) under the command of General Wu
Ying Ching (何應欽) as a soldier. Several years later,
I was promoted to the rank of Captain.

In the 22nd year of the Republic of China (1933), I
resigned from my post and came to Shanghai to seek for an
employment but without result. I then eked out a living by
hawking.

At the outbreak of the Sino-Japanese hostilities
in 1937, I joined the Chinese National Salvation Corps (中國
救亡團), situated at Kwan Te Miau (temple) in Nantao as
a member through the introduction of my friend Zau Kong Nyi
(趙剛義), Commander of the said corps.

Since the Chinese troops withdrew from Shanghai,
I stayed in a lodging house in the vicinity of Pah Shi Jao
(八仙橋) (corner of Rue Kraetzer and Rue Marc Pol), and
I did not associate with the members of the Chinese National
Salvation Corps.

In February 1938 (27th year of the Republic of
China) I went to Hankow together with one named Ping Foh Chang
(平福昌), a member of the above-mentioned corps to obtain
an employment, but with no result. During October 1938, we
(Ping Foh Chang and I) returned to Shanghai and eked out a
living by hawking.
pages.zh:
徐志浩 (Tso Ts Au)
浙江金华                      D.S.I. Wo Chen No
                                         译员
Col, C.B.H...       1939年12月14日             XXXXXX      书记员 Hsia

我叫徐志浩 (Tso Ts Au)，别名徐福林 (Tso Foh Ling)，别名王正明 (Wong Ts 'ing)，36岁，浙江金华人，未婚，H.F.A.。

16岁时，我前往广东加入何应钦将军指挥下的教导团当兵。数年后，我晋升为上尉军衔。

民国二十二年（1933年），我辞职来到上海求职，但未果。随后我以叫卖为生。

1937年中日战事爆发时，经该团团长赵刚义 (Zau Kong Nyi) 介绍，我加入位于南市的关帝庙的中国救亡团，成为其成员。

自中国军队撤离上海后，我住在八仙桥附近（克雷策路与马克·波尔路转角）的一家旅馆里，不再与中国救亡团成员往来。

民国二十七年（1938年）2月，我与上述团体的一名成员平福昌 (Ping Foh Chang) 一同前往汉口求职，但未果。1938年10月期间，我们（平福昌和我）返回上海，以叫卖为生。

pages.en:
(2)

In January, 1939 (28th year of the Republic of
China) I met one named Lee Kwok Gee (徐國琦), a member
of the Chinese National Salvation Corps and requested me to
work for the said corps again with $80.00 per month as
wages. I agreed with him about the matter. About 10 days
later, Lee Kwok Gee accompanied me to attend a dinner party
at the Dah Sai Yuen (大三元) Restaurant in the vicinity
of the Great World Amusement Resort, where I met one named
Yue Woo Ching (游河清), chief of the Chinese National
Salvation Corps, through the introduction of Lee. I then
frequently contacted with Lee.

On 17th. February, 1939 (29th day 12th. moon of the
lunar year) Lee Kwok Gee asked me to visit him in a room
(number forgotten) of the Tung Chong (東昌) Lodging House,
Avenue Joffre near Avenue Dubail. On arrival, I was told
by Lee that we should kill a traitor on 19th. February, 1939
(1st day 1st moon of the lunar year), but he did not mention
the name of the traitor. When I left the lodging house, I
was told to visit him (Lee) at 6 p.m. the following day.
I went there at the appointed time and date and met Lee Kwok
Gee, Ping Foh Chang and Tan Pau Nyi (譚宝義) in a room
of the above mentioned lodging house. A few minutes later,
Tsu San Yuen (朱山猿), a member of the Chinese National
Salvation Corps came in and joined us. As the result of the
meeting, we decided to meet again in a room of the Burlington
Hotel, Bubbling Well Road (This room was hired by Yue Woo Ching
at 5 p.m. on the 19th February, 1939.
pages.zh:
(2)

民国二十八年（1939年）1月，我遇见了中国救亡团成员李国琦 (Lee Kwok Gee)，他请求我再次为该团工作，月薪80.00元。我同意了他的提议。大约10天后，李国琦陪我去大世界游乐场附近的大三元酒楼参加晚宴，经李介绍，我在那里遇见了中国救亡团团长游河清 (Yue Woo Ching)。此后我便经常与李联系。

1939年2月17日（农历腊月二十九日），李国琦让我去霞飞路近杜美路口的东昌旅馆的一个房间（房号已忘）找他。到达后，李告诉我，我们要在1939年2月19日（农历正月初一）杀死一名汉奸，但他没有提及该汉奸的姓名。当我离开旅馆时，被告知第二天下午6点去找他（李）。我在约定的时间和日期前往，在上述旅馆的一个房间里见到了李国琦、平福昌和谭宝义 (Tan Pau Nyi)。几分钟后，中国救亡团成员朱山猿 (Tsu San Yuen) 进来加入了我们。会议结果是，我们决定在静安寺路的伯灵顿酒店的一个房间再次会面（该房间由游河清于1939年2月19日下午5点租用）。

pages.en:
(3)

At 5.30 p.m. the following day (19.2.50), I went
there and met Yue Woo Ching, Zee Kwah Gee, Ping Foh Chang,
Dan Pau Nyi and one other name unknown. Yue Woo Ching then
produced four pistols and gave one each to Zee Kwah Gee, Ping
Foh Chang and I, Yue took a pistol himself and instructed us
to meet together outside the Yue Kwang Tsung (逸光村), Yu
Yuen Road. I together with Ping Foh Chang boarded a double-
decked bus No.1 Route and went to the appointed rendezvous.
We arrived there shortly after 6 p.m.. Within a few minutes
all men had arrived at the scene. We were told by Yue Woo
Ching to murder one named Chen Loh (陳籙). Yue then led
us into an alleyway off Yu Yuen Road which is immediately
opposite the Yue Kwang Tsung, to a certain house situated
about 30 or 40 yards inside the alleyway. At the rear gateway
of this house there was an armed watchman who was disarmed
by one of us (name unknown to me). I guarded the rear door
and all servants in the kitchen, Zee Kwah Gee and Yue Woo
Ching then entered the premises whilst Ping Foh Chang, Dan
Pau Nyi, Tzu Sen Yuen and one other name unknown remained
on guard in the compound. Almost immediately after Zee Kwah
Gee and Yue Woo Ching had entered the house, I heard 3 or
4 shots fired and directly afterwards these two men left the
house by the back door and saying "The work is successfully
completed and leave here soon." We all then dispersed. I
went to stay with one of my friends named Wu (胡) on
Haining Road for the night. A few days later, Zee Kwah Gee
told me that we should flee to HONGKONG.
pages.zh:
(3)

第二天（19.2.50）下午5点30分，我前往那里，见到了游河清、徐国华 (Zee Kwah Gee)、平福昌、谭宝义以及另一名身份不明的人。游河清随后拿出四把手枪，分给徐国华、平福昌和我各一把，他自己也拿了一把，并指示我们在愚园路逸光村外会合。我和平福昌登上1路双层巴士前往指定集合地点。我们在下午6点后不久到达那里。几分钟内，所有人都到达了现场。游河清告诉我们要谋杀一名叫陈籙 (Chen Loh) 的人。游随后带领我们进入愚园路对面的一条弄堂，到达弄堂内约30或40码处的一所房子。这所房子的后门有一名武装看守，被我们中的一人（姓名不详）缴了械。我负责看守后门及厨房里的所有仆人，徐国华和游河清随后进入屋内，而平福昌、谭宝义、朱森元 (Tzu Sen Yuen) 和另一名身份不明的人则留在院子里警戒。徐国华和游河清进入房子后几乎立即，我听到三到四声枪响，紧接着这两人从后门离开房子，说道：“任务顺利完成，尽快离开这里。”随后我们各自散去。我去海宁路一位姓胡的朋友家过夜。几天后，徐国华告诉我我们应该逃往香港。

pages.en:
(4)

On 2nd or 3rd March 1939 (13th or 15th day 1st moon
of the lunar year) Lee Kwoh Gee booked four steamer tickets
from the B. & S. Co. (太古洋行). He, Lee Kwoh Gee,
Ping Poh Chang, Tsu Sen Yuen and I then went to Hongkong by
steamer (name unknown).

At the beginning of June, 1939, we returned to
Shanghai and since then we have not associated with the
Chinese National Salvation Corps.

In July, 1939, I was employed by Tse Kah Ming
(朱克敏), manager of the China Ching Hyien Toy Factory
(中国精艺玩具公司), situated at House 37, Lane 136 North
Chekiang Road, as a broker. I received 10% commission for
sales made.

On 18th December 1939, I borrowed $1.00 from one
of my fellow countrymen named Tse Piau Liang (徐標良). I
then hired a room No.33 in Railway Lodging House, situated
at House 85, Lane 51C Elgin Road at 3 p.m. on the same day.
During the night I was arrested by the S.M.Police whilst I
was in bed.

This is a true statement.

Xee Ts An
Signed and Thumb-printed
pages.zh:
(4)

1939年3月2日或3日（农历正月十三或十五日），李国琦从太古洋行预订了四张船票。他、李国琦、平福昌、朱森元和我随后乘轮船（船名不详）前往香港。

1939年6月初，我们返回上海，此后便未再与中国救亡团往来。

1939年7月，我被北浙江路136弄37号中国精艺玩具公司经理朱克敏 (Tse Kah Ming) 雇佣为经纪人。我按销售额收取10%的佣金。

1939年12月18日，我向同乡徐標良 (Tse Piau Liang) 借款1.00元。当天下午3点，我在爱文义路51C弄85号铁路旅馆租了33号房间。当晚我在床上睡觉时被上海公共租界工部局警务处逮捕。

以上陈述属实。

徐志安
签名并按手印

pages.en:
YU : PIAU LIANG (俞樑良)
HI CHUA, CH AI ANG // D.C.I. 40 Chen so
C.R.H. 2. 14.12.39 translated Hsu S. V.
----------

My name is Yue Piau Liang, age 40, native of Chinchua,
Chekiang Province, Hawker, residing at No. 41 Soong Dong Li,
Tsapoo Road, and keeping a rice cake stall at the entrance
of Lane No. 487 Elgin Road for the past two years.

At the age of 12 I became a peasant assisting my
father, Yue Pung Yee (俞奉義), in farming at Chinghua. At
the age of 20 I left Chinghua for Yue Hon Heien, Chekiang,
where I obtained employment as a coolie in the " Ung Ho"
(森和) Timber Hong,

Six years ago I came to Shanghai and obtained living
by selling stockings.

Three years ago whilst hawking on the streets I
encountered Zee Ts Au (徐走澳) (alias Zee Yeh Ling), a
fellow-countryman of mine, and who at the time was also
a peddler, since when Zee often called on me at my residence.

Since the commencement of the hostilities in 1937
I had not seen Zee Ts Au until some time in June 1938, when
he suddenly appeared at my rice cake stall and informed me
that he was at the time employed as a salesman of the China
Ching Nyien (精藝玩具) Toy Co., No. 27 Lane No. 138 off
North Chekiang Road. Zee had since occasionally come to
my home for the purpose of recreation.

At 8 p.m. on the 12.12.39 Zee called on me and
invited me to go to Room 33 of the Railway Lodging House,
Lane 510/86 Elgin Road. He also borrowed $1.00 from me.

I went to the above lodging house and at about 11 p.m.
12.12.39 we retired to bed and not long afterwards the room was
pages.zh:
俞樑良 (YU : PIAU LIANG)
浙江金华 // D.C.I. 40 Chen so
C.R.H. 2. 1939年12月14日 译员 Hsu S. V.
---

我叫俞樑良，40岁，浙江省金华人，小贩，居住在乍浦路宋洞里41号，过去两年在爱文义路487弄口经营年糕摊。

12岁时，我成为一名农民，在金华协助父亲俞奉义 (Yue Pung Yee) 务农。20岁时，我离开金华前往浙江岳河县，在“森和”木行受雇做苦力，

六年前我来到上海，靠卖袜子维持生计。

三年前，我在街头叫卖时遇到了我的同乡徐走澳 (Zee Ts Au)（别名徐叶林），当时他也是个小贩，从那以后徐经常来我家拜访。

自1937年战事开始以来，我一直没见到徐志浩，直到1938年6月的某个时候，他突然出现在我的年糕摊前，告诉我他当时受雇于北浙江路138弄27号中国精艺玩具公司的销售员。此后徐偶尔来我家娱乐。

1939年12月12日晚上8点，徐来拜访我，邀请我去爱文义路510/86弄铁路旅馆33号房间。他还向我借了1.00元。

我去了上述旅馆，大约在1939年12月12日晚上11点我们就寝，不久后房间突然

pages.en:
- 2 -

suddenly raided by a party of Police officers and we were
placed under arrest.

The reason for my arrest is unknown to me.

I am a hawker and have no connections with any
anti-Japanese organisation.

The above is my true statement.

Signed:
pages.zh:
- 2 -

遭到一队警察突袭，我们被逮捕。

我不知道我被捕的原因。

我是个小贩，与任何反日组织都没有联系。

以上是我的真实陈述。

签名：

pages.en:
Tsu Kah Ming(朱克敏)
Anhwei                                    xx D. S. I. Su
C.B.H...            14.12.39              xxxxxx      Clerk Kuh

My name is Tsu Kah Ming(朱克敏), age 38, native
of Anhwei, married, proprietor of the Ching Yyien(精藝)
toy factory, No. 27, Lane 138, North Chekiang Road.
    I was born in Anhwei. In my early boyhood, I
pursued my study at home. At the age of 14 years I went
to Huchow and acted as an apprentice in the Dah Foong Piece
Goods Shop and at the age of 19 years I transferred to the
Yien Chung Loong Piece Goods Shop. I used to come to
Shanghai to purchase goods.
    On the occupation of Huchow by Japanese troops, I
came to Shanghai and remained out of employment until I
operated the Ching Yyien toy factory in June this year.
    In July this year a sawdust dealer named Ah San
(阿三) introduced Zee Poh Ling to me. Ah San used to
frequent my shop with Zee Poh Ling to buy toys. I have
no other relations with him nor with Zee Poh Ling.so I
know nothing about their activities. I am a proper
merchant and have never taken part in anti-Japanese activi-
ties.
    This is my true statement.

                    Signed: Tsu Kah Ming.
pages.zh:
朱克敏 (Tsu Kah Ming)
安徽                                    xx D. S. I. Su
C.B.H...            1939年12月14日              xxxxxx      书记员 Kuh

我叫朱克敏，38岁，安徽人，已婚，精艺玩具厂业主，地址为北浙江路138弄27号。
    我出生在安徽。少年时期，我在家读书。14岁时我去湖州，在大丰布店当学徒，19岁时转到益中隆布店。我常来上海采购货物。
    日军占领湖州后，我来到上海，一直失业，直到今年6月经营精艺玩具厂。
    今年7月，一位名叫阿三的锯末经销商将我介绍给徐柏林 (Zee Poh Ling)。阿三常和徐柏林一起来我的店里买玩具。我与他们两人没有其他关系，因此我对他们的活动一无所知。我是个正经商人，从未参与过反日活动。
    以上是我的真实陈述。

                    签名：朱克敏。

FURTHER TO ASSISTANCE TO JAPANESE
GENDARMERIE.

At 10.15 a.m. December 15, 1939, D.S.
Hanawa reported to the undersigned that Sub-Lieut.
Katoda had telephoned asking that Chinese detectives
(C.I) accompany a Chinese informer of his to Lane
138 North Chekiang Road and keep observation on House
27 as it had been learned the house was a meeting-
place of anti-Japanese elements. The informer would
be in a position to identify wanted males. This was
agreed to provided members of the Gendarmerie in
civilian dress did not accompany them. This was
conveyed to Sub-Lieut. Katoda.

At 11.35 a.m. Sub-Lieut. Katoda attended
Crime Branch Headquarters and stated he had learned
from his informer that one Tsu Kah Ming (朱克敏)
residing No.27 Lane 138 North Chekiang Road was a
member of, or concerned in some way with, anti-Japanese
elements and he wished to effect his arrest.

At 11.50 a.m. a party consisting of D.S.
Hanawa, D.S.I. Wu, C.D.S. 2, C.D.C.s 206 and 212
and the undersigned accompanied Sub-Lieut. Katoda
to the address mentioned where

关于进一步协助日本宪兵队事宜。

1939年12月15日上午10点15分，侦探长 Hanawa 向本人报告称，Katoda 少尉打电话要求中国探员（C.I）陪同他的一名中国线民前往北浙江路138弄，并对27号房屋进行监视，因为获悉该房屋是反日分子的聚会地点。该线民能够指认被通缉的男子。前提是便衣宪兵队成员不陪同他们，对此表示同意。此事已传达给 Katoda 少尉。

上午11点35分，Katoda 少尉来到罪案科总部，称他从线民处得知，居住在北浙江路138弄27号的朱克敏是反日分子的一员或以某种方式参与其中，他希望将其逮捕。

上午11点50分，由侦探长 Hanawa、侦探副督察 Wu、华籍高级警长2名、华籍警长206号和21号以及本人组成的小组陪同 Katoda 少尉前往上述地址，在那里

pages.en:
3/2

Tsu Kah Ming (朱克敏), 38, Anhwei,
married, proprietor of the Ching Nylen
(精藝) toy factory
was arrested. He is now the 3rd. arrest.

A search of the room occupied by him proved
fruitless regarding incriminating evidence other than
a letter addressed to Tse Foh Ling (徐福林),
the 1st. named, care of the 3rd. named.

The letter reads as follows:-

"Please call at my office between 1 and
5 p.m. on the 10th. instant as there is a dealer who
wishes to place an export order with you for (toy)
goats.
Signed: Tsou Li Zah (周澤洋)
Attorney-at-law
56 Sou An Li (首安里),
Boulevard de Montigny.
Dated 9.12.39."

The fact of incriminating evidence not being
found is not surprising in view of the fact the 3rd.
named's room was visited at 1.30 a.m. December 15, 1939
by the same party in order to verify a statement by the
1st. named.

Sub-Lieut. Katada insisted that two S.M.P.
Chinese detectives be left on the premises to arrest
"suspicious" Chinese. They were to remain until 12
mid-night.
pages.zh:
3/2

朱克敏 (Tsu Kah Ming)，38岁，安徽人，
已婚，精藝 (Ching Nylen) 玩具厂业主
被捕。这是他第三次被捕。

对其所住房间的搜查除了一封寄给徐福林 (Tse Foh Ling)（即第一名嫌疑人），由第三名嫌疑人转交的信件外，未发现任何罪证。

信件内容如下：-

“请于本月10日下午1点至5点之间到我办公室来，因为有一位商人希望向你下达（玩具）山羊的出口订单。
签名：周澤洋 (Tsou Li Zah)
律师
蒙梯尼路 (Boulevard de Montigny) 首安里 (Sou An Li) 56号。
日期：1939年12月9日。”

鉴于第三名嫌疑人的房间曾于1939年12月15日凌晨1点30分被同一伙人访问过，以核实第一名嫌疑人的陈述，因此未发现罪证这一事实并不令人惊讶。

加田 (Katada) 少尉坚持要求留下两名工部局警务处 (S.M.P.) 华籍侦探在现场，以逮捕“可疑”华人。他们需留守至午夜12点。

pages.en:
3/3

It was distinctly explained to Sub-Lieut.
Katoda that the detectives were not in a position
to identify whoever he might name as suspect inasmuch
he had no informer with him and that should it subse-
quently be shown that a wanted man had visited the
premises and had been allowed to go for lack of proof
the onus of same would rest entirely with him. No
names of suspects were mentioned.

Under these conditions C.D.C.s 206 and 212
were left on the premises.

The detention of the 3rd. named was requested
pending definite evidence being produced against him.

A statement will be taken from him.

West Hongkew Station informed of visit.

〔此处为手写签名及 D.S.I. 字样〕
pages.zh:
3/3

已向加田 (Katoda) 少尉明确解释，侦探们无法指认他可能点名的任何嫌疑人，因为他身边没有线人；如果随后显示有一名通缉犯曾到访该处并因缺乏证据而被放行，全部责任将完全由他承担。未提及任何嫌疑人姓名。

在此情况下，华籍侦探 (C.D.C.s) 206号和212号被留在现场。

要求在提出针对第三名嫌疑人的确凿证据之前将其拘留。

将对他进行录供。

已通知西虹口巡捕房此次行动。

He admitted being a look-out at the murder

FURTHER TO : ASSISTANCE TO JAPANESE GENDARMERIE

The three statements made by the 1st accused
Dan Pau Yee alias Dan Pau Nyi, one statement made by
the 2nd accused Dan Pau Zung and four statements made
by the 3rd accused Wong Yee Ping alias Ping Poh Chang,
at Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters, have all been
translated and are attached.

The 1st and 3rd accused admit having been
concerned in the assassination of the late Chen Lot,
who was the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Reformed
Government.

The 2nd accused, who is the brother of the
1st accused, denies having taken any part in this crime,
and states he was not even aware that his brother was
concerned in the crime until after it was committed.
Also the 2nd accused is not implicated by the 1st and
3rd accused.

Statements have also been taken at C.B.H.Q.
from the 1st and 3rd accused and they freely admit the
part they took in this crime. Statements attached.

REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of _DAN PAU NYI_ (譚保義), alias DAN PAU YEE (譚保義)
native of _Sungkiang_ taken by me _D. S. I. Pryde_
at _C. B. H. Q._ on the _311.39_ and interpreted by _Clerk Hsu_

My name is Dau Pau Nyi alias Dan Pau Yee, age 23,
native of Sungkiang. The statement I made to the S.M.P.
on June 30th 1939 is not true. I now voluntarily made
the following true statement.
I was born in Ts Ching Tsung near Sungkiang where
my father is a farmer. From the age of 8 years to 14 years
I was educated at my native place. From the age of 14 years
to 17 years I attended the Sungkiang Middle School. From
17 years to 20 years of age I attended the Tsung Hwa Business
School at Loh Ka Peng, Nantae, where I graduated in May 1937.
I then went to Henyang, Hunan, where I was employed as a
surveyor by the Hai Yee Ping (漢冶萍) Mine. When the Sino-
Japanese hostilities commenced I evacuated to Hankow and
stayed with friends, being unemployed, and later obtained
employment in an iron foundary. About July 1938 I went to
Ling-li, Hunan and entered the Military Depot there and
received three months training. I was then posted to Changsha.
About the beginning of the year 1939 together with two com-
rades named Zee Kwoh Gee (徐國琦) and Tsu San Yuen (朱山猿)
came to Shanghai via Ningpo and arrived in Shanghai on or about
Feb. 1st. 1939. Zee Kwoh Gee was in charge of the party and
on arrival in Shanghai, got in touch with Yue Woo Ching
(游河清). I was told to stand-by, so I went to live with
my cousin named Tseu Ts Ming (周子明) on Route Frelupt.
Our instructions when we were sent to Shanghai was to do
what we could for our country and to keep in touch with
Yue Woo Ching. About one week before Chinese New Year

以下是由我，高级侦探普赖德 (Pryde, D. S. I.)，于1939年11月3日 (_311.39_) 在刑事科总部 (_C. B. H. Q._) 对松江籍人士 _譚保義_ (DAN PAU NYI)，又名 _譚保義_ (DAN PAU YEE) 进行的讯问记录，由书记员徐 (Hsu) 翻译。

我叫谭保义 (Dau Pau Nyi)，又名谭保义 (Dan Pau Yee)，23岁，松江人。我于1939年6月30日向工部局警务处 (S.M.P.) 所作的陈述不属实。现在我自愿作出以下真实陈述。
我出生在松江附近的诸泾宗 (Ts Ching Tsung)，父亲是农民。从8岁到14岁，我在家乡接受教育。从14岁到17岁，我就读于松江中学。从17岁到20岁，我就读于南台 (Nantae) 罗家浜 (Loh Ka Peng) 的中华商业学校 (Tsung Hwa Business School)，并于1937年5月毕业。随后我前往湖南衡阳 (Henyang)，受雇于汉冶萍 (Hai Yee Ping) 矿务局担任测量员。中日敌对行动开始时，我撤离至汉口，与朋友同住，处于失业状态，后来在一家铸铁厂找到工作。约1938年7月，我前往湖南零陵 (Ling-li)，进入那里的军事仓库接受了三个月的训练。随后我被派往长沙。约1939年初，我与两名名为徐国琦 (Zee Kwoh Gee) 和朱山猿 (Tsu San Yuen) 的同伴经宁波来到上海，于1939年2月1日左右抵达上海。徐国琦负责该小组，抵达上海后，他与游河清 (Yue Woo Ching) 取得了联系。我被告知待命，于是我去弗雷鲁普路 (Route Frelupt) 与我的表亲周子明 (Tseu Ts Ming) 同住。我们被派往上海时的指令是尽我们所能为国家效力，并与游河清保持联系。大约在春节前一周

- 2 -

I went to see Zee Kwoh Gee who was staying at the Kap Tai
(國泰) Hotel, French Concession and he informed me that
we would soon have to start operations. Zee Kwoh Gee then
moved to the Tung Chong (東昌) Hotel, Avenue Joffre, and I
and Tseu San Yuen used to regularly visit there. About
3 p.m. on New Year's Day, Zee Kwoh Gee took me to see Yue
Woo Ching at the Burlington Hotel. We arrived there at
about 4 p.m. and there were altogether eight persons present.
Yue Woo Ching issued pistols to certain members. I only saw
four pistols issued, and instructed us to go to the Yue Kwang
Tsung (燦光村), Yu Yuen Road wait there until the whole
party arrived. The following are the names of the persons
concerned.

Serial No. 1. Yue Woo Ching l/e of party and armed with
a pistol.

" " 2. Zee Kwoh Gee armed with a pistol.
" " 3. Yue Ping San armed with a pistol.
" " 4. Tau San Yuen
" " 5. Dan Pau Nyi
" " 6. Ping Foh Chang (3rd accused) armed with a pistol
" " 7. Lieu Hai San
" " 8. Lien

I left the Burlington Hotel together with Zee Kwoh
Gee (Serial No. 2) and Tau San Yuen (Serial No. 3) and we
walked to the appointed rendezvous. We arrived there at
approximately 6 p.m. and it was already dark. The other
five members of the party were already at the rendezvous

我去看望住在法租界国泰 (Kap Tai) 酒店的徐国琦 (Zee Kwoh Gee)，他告诉我我们很快就要开始行动。随后徐国琦搬到了霞飞路 (Avenue Joffre) 的东昌 (Tung Chong) 酒店，我和朱山猿 (Tseu San Yuen) 经常去那里拜访。约元旦下午3点，徐国琦带我去伯灵顿酒店 (Burlington Hotel) 见游河清 (Yue Woo Ching)。我们大约下午4点到达那里，当时共有八人在场。游河清向某些成员发放了手枪。我只看到发放了四把手枪，并指示我们前往愚园路 (Yu Yuen Road) 的燦光村 (Yue Kwang Tsung) 等待，直到全体人员到达。以下是相关人员姓名。

序号 1. 游河清 (Yue Woo Ching)，小组领导，配备手枪。

" " 2. 徐国琦 (Zee Kwoh Gee)，配备手枪。
" " 3. 俞平三 (Yue Ping San)，配备手枪。
" " 4. 陶山猿 (Tau San Yuen)
" " 5. 谭保义 (Dan Pau Nyi)
" " 6. 平福昌 (Ping Foh Chang)（第三被告），配备手枪
" " 7. 刘海山 (Lieu Hai San)
" " 8. 连 (Lien)

我与徐国琦（序号2）和陶山猿（序号3）一起离开伯灵顿酒店，步行前往指定的集合地点。我们大约在下午6点到达那里，天色已黑。小组的其他五名成员已经到达集合地点

on our arrival. Yue Woo Ching led us into an alleyway
opposite to the Yue Kwang Taung and to a house about 50
yards inside the alleyway. There was an armed watchman
at the rear door to the compound of this house. This
watchman was disarmed by Lieu Han San (Serial No. 7) and six
of our party entered the compound, namely:-
1. Yue Woo Ching
2. Zee Kwoh Gee
3. Yue Ping San
4. Tsu San Yuen
5. Dan Pau Yeo (myself)
6. Ping Foh Chang (3rd accused)

We took the watchman inside with us. Lieu Han San
and Lieu (Serial Nos. 7 & 8) remained outside in the alleyway
on guard. Yue Woo Ching, Zee Kwoh Gee and Yue Ping San
(Serial Nos. 1, 2 & 3) entered the house by the back door,
which was not locked. Tsu San Yuo, myself and Ping Foh Chang
remained in the compound guarding the watchman. Almost imme-
diately after the three above stated men had entered the house
I heard four or five shots fired and within a few minutes these
three men came out of the house by the back door (point of
entry) and said "all finished" (好 了 ). I then left the scene
together with the others and got into a motor car that was
waiting on Yu Yuen Road outside the alleyway together with
Yue Woo Ching (Serial No. 1) and three or four others. I
cannot now remember who these others actually were, neither
do I know who the car belonged to or who brought it to the

当我们到达时。余阿清（Yue Woo Ching）带领我们进入源光邨对面的一条弄堂，并进入弄堂内约 50 码处的一所房屋。该房屋后院的门口有一名持枪看守。这名看守被刘汉山（Lieu Han San，编号 7）缴械，我们一行六人进入院内，即：
1. 余阿清（Yue Woo Ching）
2. 徐国琦（Zee Kwoh Gee）
3. 余品山（Yue Ping San）
4. 朱三元（Tsu San Yuen）
5. 谭宝义（Dan Pau Yeo，即本人）
6. 车福昌（Ping Foh Chang，第三被告）

我们将看守带进院内。刘汉山和刘某（Lieu，编号 7 和 8）留在弄堂外警戒。余阿清、徐国琦和余品山（编号 1、2 和 3）通过未上锁的后门进入屋内。朱三元、本人和车福昌留在院内看守那名警卫。在上述三人进入屋内后几乎立即，我听到四五声枪响，几分钟后，这三人从后门（进入点）出来，说“好了”。随后我与其他人一起离开现场，与余阿清（编号 1）及另外三四人在弄堂外的愚园路（Yu Yuen Road）上了一辆等候的汽车。我现在记不起这些其他人究竟是谁，也不知道这辆车属于谁，或是谁把它开到

- 4 -

scene. The car drove to some place in the French Concession,
I do not know the exact location, and we got out and I took
a ricksha and went to the Tung Chong Lodging House, Avenue
Joffre, where Zee Kwok Gee was living at that time. The
following morning I ascertained from the newspapers that
the person who had been murdered was one named Chen Loh,
the Minister for Foreign Affairs of the Reformed Government.
Prior to that I did not know who the man was who was murdered.
I did not see Zee Kwok Gee again in Shanghai. A few days
after the assassination Tsu San Yuen (Serial No.4) came to
see me and told me it was not safe to stop in Shanghai
and gave me $80.00, telling me to go to Hongkong. I then
went back to my cousin's home and was given a letter which
had been left there by Zee Kwok Gee. This letter contained
instructions to proceed to Hongkong and put up at the Tai
Lai Hotel. I arrived in Hongkong about March 15th 1939 and
stopped at the stated hotel. Zee Kwok Gee came to see me
and the following day I attended a dinner given by one named
Tai Lih (戴笠) at which Yue Woo Ching, Zee Kwok Gee, Yue
Ping San, Ping Poh Chang were present. Nothing was mentioned
at the dinner about the assassination of Chen Loh. Tai Lih
gave us a fountain pen each.
Tai Lih is an influential representative of the
Nationalist Government in Hongkong. I do not know whether
he comes to Shanghai. I stayed in Hongkong for approximately
two months and then received instructions from Yue Woo Ching
to return to Shanghai together with Yue Ping San, Tsu San

现场的。汽车开往法租界的某个地方，我不知道确切地点，我们下车后，我雇了一辆黄包车前往霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）的东中旅馆（Tung Chong Lodging House），徐国琦当时住在那里。第二天早上，我从报纸上得知被杀者名叫陈箓（Chen Loh），是维新政府的外交部长。在此之前，我不知道被杀者是谁。此后我在上海再未见过徐国琦。暗杀发生几天后，朱三元（编号 4）来看我，告诉我留在上海不安全，并给了我 80 美元，让我去香港。于是我回到表亲家，收到一封徐国琦留在那里的信。信中指示前往香港，入住大利酒店（Tai Lai Hotel）。我于 1939 年 3 月 15 日左右抵达香港，并入住所述酒店。徐国琦来看我，次日我参加了一个名叫戴笠（Tai Lih）的人举办的晚宴，余阿清、徐国琦、余品山、车福昌均在座。晚宴上未提及陈箓被暗杀一事。戴笠送给我们每人一支钢笔。
戴笠是国民政府在港有影响力的代表。我不知道他是否来上海。我在香港停留了大约两个月，然后接到余阿清的指示，与余品山、朱三

My proper name is Ping Foh Chang, age 24, native
of Funing. The statement that I made to the S.M.Police
on June 30th. 1939 under the name of Wong Yee Ping is not
true. My name is not Wong Yee Ping and I have never been
known by that name. I now voluntarily make the following
true statement:-

I was born on Han Tsong Road, Chapei. From the
age of 9 years to 13 years I attended the San Nyih (村業)
Primary School, Kong Ying Ka, Nantae. From 13 years to
16 years of age I attended the Yoh Ching (育青) Middle
School, Kiangwan. From 16 years to 20 years of age I worked
with my father as an optician in his shop on Tso Zai Road,
Nantao. In the year 1935, when I was 20 years of age went
to Hankow and obtained a position as Inspector in the Police
Bureau there. In June 1937, I resigned from the Hankow
Police Bureau and came to Shanghai and stayed with my father
in Nantse. When the Sino-Japanese hostilities broke out
in Peiping on July 7th. 1937 together with a number of
friends we decided to join some unit and help to resist the
Japanese. I did not do any active work until the hostilities
broke out in Shanghai when I joined a Special Mobile Unit
under the command of one named Zen. When the Chinese
Army retreated from Shanghai I remained here and took no
further active part until February 1938 when I went to Hankow
via Hongkong, where I met Tseu Yoh Van (朱学範), an
acquaintance of mine, who introduced me to Lee Zen Shang
(李尚向), who was in charge of a Section of the Military

以下为车福昌（Ping Foh Chang）之陈述，该人系阜宁籍，由本人 D.S.I. Pryde 于 1939 年 11 月 5 日在中央捕房总部 C.1 室录取，并由侯职员（Clerk Hau）翻译

我的真名是车福昌，24 岁，阜宁籍。我于 1939 年 6 月 30 日以王义平（Wong Yee Ping）之名向上海公共租界警务处所作的陈述不属实。我不叫王义平，也从未以此名闻名。现在我自愿作出以下真实陈述：

我出生在闸北汉中路（Han Tsong Road）。9 岁至 13 岁时，我就读于南台江湾桥（Kong Ying Ka, Nantae）的村业小学（San Nyih Primary School）。13 岁至 16 岁时，我就读于江湾的育青中学（Yoh Ching Middle School）。16 岁至 20 岁时，我在父亲位于南台左宰路（Tso Zai Road）的眼镜店里协助父亲工作。1935 年，我 20 岁时前往汉口，并在当地警察局获得督察一职。1937 年 6 月，我从汉口警察局辞职来到上海，与父亲住在南台。1937 年 7 月 7 日北平爆发中日战事时，我与一些朋友决定加入某支部队以协助抗日。在上海战事爆发前，我没有从事任何积极活动；上海战事爆发后，我加入了一个由一名姓曾（Zen）的人指挥的特别机动队。当中国军队从上海撤退时，我留在这里，直到 1938 年 2 月才经香港前往汉口，在那里我遇到了熟人朱学範（Tseu Yoh Van），他将我介绍给负责军事委员会某处的李尚向（Lee Zen Shang）。李尚向派我去湖南陆丰（Ling Lee）的军事仓库受训。我在那里待了大约 3 个月。随后我接到指示，与另外三名分别名为甦（Chieng Su）、施政（Sze Tsung）和林子仁（Ling Ts Zung）的人一同前往上海，抵达后入住法租界的亚祖旅馆（Yah Tsu Lodging House），会有代表与我们联络。我们经香港来到上海，在 1938 年双十节过后不久抵达，并按指示住在该旅馆。几天后，有人（姓名不详）来看我，并给了我钱。施政和我住在不同的地址，始终与代表保持联系。就在农历新年前夕，一个叫游所清（Yeu Woo Ching）的人来看我，问我是否有勇气为国民政府做一些积极的工作，我同意了。除夕那天，我去见住在伯灵顿酒店（Burlington Hotel）的余阿清，他指示我第二天一早在那里与他见面。大年初一我去了伯灵顿酒店，余阿清指示我去法租界拉格伦路（Rue Legrene）附近一所房子，那是一个姓刘（Lieu）的人的家，从他那里拿五支手枪带到伯灵顿酒店。我按指示去了那所房子，从刘某那里拿到五支手枪，带回伯灵顿酒店交给余阿清。当天下午 4 点前，八个人聚集在房间里，余阿清告诉我们

Committee. Lee Zau Shang sent me to Ling Lee (陸豐) in Hunan Province for training at the Military Depot there. I remained there for about 3 months. I then received instructions to proceed to Shanghai together with three others named Chieng Su (甦), Sze Tsung (施政) and Ling Ts Zung (林子仁) and on arrival there to put up at the Yah Tsu Lodging House, French-town and some representative would get in touch with us. We came to Shanghai via Hongkong and arrived shortly after the Double Tenth Anniversary 1938, and stayed at the lodging house as instructed. A few days later some person (name unknown) came to see me, and gave me money. Sze Tsung and myself lived at various addresses, always keeping in touch with the representative and just before the Chinese New Year one named Yeu Woo Ching (游所清) came to see me and asked me if I had the courage to do some active work for the Nationalist Government, and I agreed to do so. On Chinese New Years Eve I went to see Yue Woo Ching, who was staying at the Burlington Hotel and he instructed me to meet him there early the following day. I went to the Burlington Hotel on Chinese New Year's day and Yue Woo Ching instructed to go to a certain house near Rue Legrene, French Concession, the home of one named Lieu (劉), and get five pistols from him and bring them to the Burlington Hotel. I went to the house as instructed, obtained the five pistols from Lieu and returned with them to the Burlington Hotel and handed them over to Yue Woo Ching. By 4 p.m. same day eight persons had gathered together in the room and Yue Woo Ching told us

then entered the compound. Serial Nos.1,2 & 3 Yue Woo Ching,
Zee Kwoh Gee and Yue Ping San entered the house by the
back door which was unlocked, whilst Serial No.s 4,5 & 6 Tsu
San Yuen, Dan Pau Nyi and myself remained on guard in the
compound. Serial No.7 Lieu Han San remained in the alleyway
guarding the watchman. I do not know what happened to Serial
No.8 Lieu. Almost immediately after the three men had
entered the house I heard 5 or 6 shots fired and directly
afterwards these three men left the house by the back door
saying"the work is successfully completed" (事清成功 ).
We all then dispersed. I walked to the end of the alleyway
where I threw my pistol on the ground and walked east along
Yu Yuen Road to a bus stop and boarded a bus and rode to St.
Georges. I then obtained a hire car at the Ford Hire Service
Station there and returned to a small lodging house on Rue
Marche where I was living at the time. The following morning
I saw the report of the assassination on the newspapers and
it was not until then that I knew that the person who was
murdered was named Chen Loh and was the Minister of Foreign
Affairs of the Reformed Government. At about 9 a.m. Zee Kwoh
Gee (Serial No.2) visited me but we did not discuss the
assassination. Several days later Zee Kwoh Gee visited me
again and took me to see Yue Ping San(Serial No.3) at the
Loong Koong Restaurant, French Concession and we three men

all arranged to go to Hongkong together. On or about February
28th. 1939, we left Shanghai aboard the s.s. Tah Yuen (太元),
a B. & S. Steamer and arrived in Hongkong about four days
later. On arrival, Zee Kwoh Gee (Serial No.2) took me to the
Loh Koh Hotel where we met Yue Woo Ching (Serial No.1). About
10 days later, I attended a dinner party at the King Loong
Restaurant, given by one named Tai Lih (戴笠). All the
other persons who took part in the murder of Chen Loh were
present at this dinner. Tai Lih presented each one of us
with a fountain pen and except for the subsistence allowance
I received from a representative (name unknown) whilst in
Shanghai I have received no payment whatsoever for the
part I took in this assassination. Tai Lih is an influential
representative of the Nationalist Government in Hongkong and
to the best of my knowledge he always stays in Hongkong.
About the end of May 1939 I together with Yue Ping
San, Tsu San Yuen and Dan Pau Yee (1st. accused) (Serial Nos.
3,4 and 5) returned to Shanghai. Two subordinates of Tai Lih
named Mau Van Li (毛万里) and Wong (王) also left Hongkong
for Shanghai by a different steamer. On arrival in Shanghai
Dan Pau Yee (Serial No.5, 1st. accused) and I stayed in the
Ya Fee Lodging House, Rue Paul Beau whilst Yue Ping San and
Tsu San Yuen (Serials Nos.3 & 4) stayed at the Dah Zung
Lodging House, Rue Auguste Boppe. My instructions were to

re further activities. Wong at this time was stopping at
the Dah Tsoong and Dah Faung Hotels. On 29.6.39, I was

Tah Yuen）离开上海，约四天后抵达香港。抵达后，Zee Kwoh Gee（编号2）带我去了罗阁酒店（Loh Koh Hotel），在那里我们见到了Yue Woo Ching（编号1）。大约十天后，我参加了一位名叫戴笠（Tai Lih）的人在金隆餐厅（King Loong Restaurant）举办的晚宴。所有参与谋杀陈箓（Chen Loh）的其他人员都出席了这次晚宴。戴笠送给我们每人一支钢笔，除了我在上海期间从一名代表（姓名不详）那里领取的生活津贴外，我没有因参与此次暗杀行动而收到任何报酬。戴笠是国民政府在港的一名有影响力的代表，据我所知，他一直住在香港。1939年5月底，我与Yue Ping San、Tsu San Yuen和Dan Pau Yee（第一被告）（编号3、4和5）返回上海。戴笠的两名下属，名叫毛万里（Mau Van Li）和王（Wong），也乘另一艘轮船从香港前往上海。抵达上海后，Dan Pau Yee（编号5，第一被告）和我住在保罗·博路（Rue Paul Beau）的雅菲旅馆（Ya Fee Lodging House），而Yue Ping San和Tsu San Yuen（编号3和4）则住在奥古斯特·博佩路（Rue Auguste Boppe）的大中旅馆（Dah Zung Lodging House）。我的指令是与名叫王的人保持联系，他将下达关于后续行动的命令。当时王住在大中酒店（Dah Tsoong Hotel）和大丰酒店（Dah Faung Hotel）。1939年6月29日，我

an Pao Yee (譚保義) alias Dan Pao Hyi (譚保義)
Sungkiang                                      Sub-Lieut. Kstod:
Jap. Gen. H. Qs.          23.10.39

The above described person made the following state-
ment at the Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters on Oct. 23, 1939.
............................
My name is Dan Pao Yee alias Dan Pao Hyi, age
23, Chinese, native of S-Kin Village, Sungkiang Hsien,
Kiangsu Province, unemployed, residing at Room 14 Yah
Fee Lodging House, 66 Rue Paul Beau.
FAMILY
    My family consists of father, age 59, mother age
61, elder brother, age 30, sister-in-law age 30, 4 of
nieces and nephews and myself. Since the outbreak of
Sino-Japanese hostilities in 1937, I have seldom returned
home. My parents live in the native place and engaged in
farming, while the elder brother is a corn-chandler with
shop at No. 426, Route Frelupt, F.C. In the native village
we have immovables estimated between $3,000.00 and $4,000.00.
RELIGION. Nil.
CAREER
    I was born in S-Kin Village, Sungkiang Hsien,
Kiangsu Province. After a course at a primary school
in the native village I entered the Sungkiang Middle
School at the age of 15, and when I had completed the
whole course at the age of 18, I successively entered
the Shanghai Central China (Trade) School in Nantao.
I completed the course of this school in May 1937.
Re. Political activities and Assassination of Cheng
Loh (程洛), Minister for Foreign Affairs of the

松江                                      副官 Kstod：
日本宪兵队总部          1939年10月23日

上述人员于1939年10月23日在日本宪兵队总部作了如下陈述 ____ 
我叫谭保义，又名谭保义，23岁，中国人，籍贯江苏省松江县S-Kin村，无业，居住在保罗·博路66号雅菲旅馆14号房间。
家庭情况
    我家中有父亲（59岁）、母亲（61岁）、哥哥（30岁）、嫂子（30岁）、四个侄子女以及我自己。自1937年中日敌对行动爆发以来，我很少回家。父母住在老家务农，哥哥在法租界斐伦路（Route Frelupt）426号开了一家粮店。在老家村里，我们有价值估计在3,000.00至4,000.00美元之间的不动产。
宗教信仰：无。
履历
    我出生于江苏省松江县S-Kin村。在村里读完小学后，我15岁时进入松江中学，18岁完成全部课程后，相继进入位于南市的上海华中（贸易）学校。我于1937年5月从该校毕业。
关于政治活动及刺杀维新政府外交部长程洛（Cheng Loh）一事

pages.en:
Reformed Government.

As I stated above, I completed the course of the Central China school in May 1937, when through the introduction of this school I was employed as a surveyor in the Hai Ts Ping (海太平) Co., in Hengyang, Hunan, lasting for about half a year until the outbreak of Sino-Japanese hostilities. Owing to the outbreak of hostilities I was compelled to remove to Hankow, where I lived on friends of mine for about 3 or 4 months and then made a living by working in an Iron Plant for about 3 or 4 months.

Towards July 1938, I entered the Special Section of the Military Committee in Ling-li, Hunan. The course covers 6 months but after three months I together with nine others was detailed to Changsha, where we remained almost inactive until we called back to Ling-li again, one month later. On February 1st or 2nd 1939, Tsoo Kuo Gee (徐国琦); Tsu San Yu (朱山猿) and I were detailed to Shanghai via Ningpo. Tsoo Kao Gee intended to get in touch with Yue Ho Ching (岳河清) and told me to stand ready to meet any urgent call. I stayed in the 2nd floor room of Yih Yuen (一元) Piece goods shop, Chi Yih Li, Route Prelupt, which was the home of my brother named Tseu Ts Ming (周子敏). The work on which we were detailed here was to discharge the functions of the Military Committee and to make preparation for its effective performance, keeping in touch with Yue Ho Ching, a graduate of former special section of Military Committee.
pages.zh:
如上所述，我于1937年5月从华中学校毕业，随后通过该校介绍，在湖南衡阳的海太平公司（Hai Ts Ping Co.）担任测量员，为期约半年，直至中日敌对行动爆发。由于战事爆发，我被迫迁往汉口，在那里依靠朋友生活了约三到四个月，随后在一家铁厂工作了约三到四个月以维持生计。

1938年7月左右，我进入位于湖南陵里（Ling-li）的军事委员会特别班。该课程为期六个月，但在三个月后，我和其他九人被派往长沙，在那里我们几乎无所事事，直到一个月后又被召回陵里。1939年2月1日或2日，徐国琦（Tsoo Kuo Gee）、朱山猿（Tsu San Yu）和我被经宁波派往上海。徐国琦打算与岳河清（Yue Ho Ching）取得联系，并让我随时准备应对紧急召唤。我住在法租界斐伦路（Route Prelupt）积义里一元（Yih Yuen）百货店二楼的房间，那是我哥哥周子敏（Tseu Ts Ming）的家。我们被派到这里的工作是履行军事委员会的职能，并为有效执行这些职能做准备，同时与前军事委员会特别班毕业生岳河清保持联系。

pages.en:
- 3 -

Now I shall state regarding the assassination of
Cheng Lok ( ). We came to Shanghai on February 1st, or
2nd. I stayed at Route Frelupt, F.C., while Zee Kao Gee
and Tsu San Yu put up at the Sun Tai (国泰) Hotel located in
front of the Great World Amusement Resort. One week before
the Chinese New Year we were noticed by Zee Gee Gee (徐國琦)
to be ready to meet any urgent call, so we removed to Tung
Chong Hotel, venue Joffre, F.C.

About 3 p.m. on the Chinese New Year (19.2.59),
Zee Kao Gee told me to go to the Burlington Hotel, on
Bubbling Well Road to attend an urgent work, and I together
with Zee Kao Gee and Tsu San Yu proceeded to the 3rd floor
of the Burlington Hotel.

In the meantime the following persons presented
themselves there : -

1. 1/c of group Yuo Ho Ching (徐阿清) "O", "V"
2. Member Zee Kao Gee (徐國琦) "O", "V"
3. " Yuo Ping Sen (尤品山) "O", "V"
4. " Tsu San Yue (朱三樣) "X"
5. " Dan Pao Hyi (保義) "X"
6. " Ping Foo Chung (平福昌) "X", "O"
7. Former Chief of the guard for Cheng Yeh Liang (張業良)
Lieu Hai Sen (劉海山) "X"
8. Lieu (劉 ) "X"

(note). Mark "O" indicates a person armed with a pistol.
" "V" " " " entered the house and
" "X" " " " fired,
remained on guard outside.
pages.zh:
- 3 -

现在我将陈述关于刺杀程洛（Cheng Lok）的情况。我们于2月1日或2日抵达上海。我住在法租界斐伦路，而徐国琦和朱山猿则住在大世界游乐场对面的国泰酒店（Sun Tai Hotel）。农历新年前一周，徐国琦（Zee Gee Gee）通知我们要随时准备应对紧急召唤，因此我们搬到了法租界霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）的东昌酒店（Tung Chong Hotel）。

农历新年（1939年2月19日）下午3点左右，徐国琦让我去静安寺路的奔宁汉姆酒店（Burlington Hotel）处理一项紧急工作，我便与徐国琦和朱山猿一同前往奔宁汉姆酒店三楼。

与此同时，以下人员出现在那里：

1. 小组组长 岳河清（Yuo Ho Ching，原文注：徐阿清） "O", "V"
2. 成员 徐国琦（Zee Kao Gee） "O", "V"
3. " 尤品山（Yuo Ping Sen） "O", "V"
4. " 朱三样（Tsu San Yue） "X"
5. " 谭保义（Dan Pao Hyi） "X"
6. " 平福昌（Ping Foo Chung） "X", "O"
7. 前张业良（Cheng Yeh Liang）的警卫长 刘海山（Lieu Hai Sen） "X"
8. 刘（Lieu） "X"

（注）标记“O”表示携带手枪的人员。
“V”表示进入屋内的人员
“X”表示开枪射击，并在外面负责警戒的人员。

pages.en:
- 4 -

hen all members were present Yue Ho Ching produced
4 large pistols from a wooden box. He took one for himself
and the remainders were handed in to Zee Kao Gee, Yue
Ping Sun and Ping Foo Chang, each for one man. He then
informed us that we were going to assassinate one Cheng
who was the high official of the Reformed Government and
who had just arrived at Shanghai from Nanking. Yue Ho
Ching assigned the part to be played by each of us and then
we left there for Yu Yuen Road at 8 p.m.

Zee Kao Gee, Tsu San Yue and I went on foot, place
being known to Zee Kao Gee. After arriving at Yu Yuen Road
we were loitering in its vicinity for about 10 minutes.
Then I stood guard while the persons mentioned above entered
the house through the rear gate. Those entered first,
dragged watchmen out and threatened them not to raise an
alarm with the pain of being shot. Posts and access are
illustrated as follow:-
pages.zh:
- 4 -

当所有成员到齐后，岳河清从一个木箱中拿出4支大号手枪。他自己拿了一支，其余的分发给徐国琦、尤品山和平福昌，每人一支。随后他通知我们，我们要去刺杀一名姓程的高官，此人是维新政府的高级官员，刚从南京抵达上海。岳河清分配了我们每个人的任务，然后我们在晚上8点离开那里前往愚园路。

徐国琦、朱三样和我步行前往，地点由徐国琦熟悉。到达愚园路后，我们在附近徘徊了大约10分钟。然后我负责放哨，上述人员通过后门进入屋内。先进去的人将看守拖出来，威胁他们不得报警，否则就开枪射杀。岗位和入口图示如下：-

pages.en:
- 2 -
Prior to our departure from the Burlington Hotel,
Yue Ho Ching showed me a pamphlet, which, he stated, was
to be distributed. It was a sheet of paper 5.6 ins. X 4 ins.,
bearing characters of anti-Japanese nature written with a
lead-pencil.
I heard several reports of shot coming from the
house and soon came the men out of the house crying "O.K!
O.K!"
At that moment some one cried "Motor car, Motor car",
and we boarded the car which was waiting for us. If I
remember correctly five men boarded the vehicle.
We left the motor on Avenue Joffre, I then put up
at Tung Cheng Hotel. In the following day's paper, I learned
that our victim had been Cheng Loh, Minister of Foreign
Affairs of the Reformed Government.
Several days later, Zee Kae Gee notified me that we were
in danger here in Shanghai and suggested to me to take refuge
in Hongkong, giving me $80.00 for passage. On or about
March 1941, I went to Hongkong aboard the S.S. Ho Sung (何松)
(British ship). Prior to my departure I, in accordance
with instructions, put up at the Tai Lai Hotel located along
the wharf on an unknown Road. On the following day Zee
Kae Gee called at me there. Two days after arrival in
Hongkong, I attended the dinner party given by Ton Lin (戴笠)
at Kin Loong (金龍) Restaurant, Nanking Road. Those present
at the dinner were Yue Yih (程伯清), Zee Kah (徐國琦),
Yue Ping San, Tan Sun Yue, Dan Jao Nyi, Ping Foo Chang and
pages.zh:
- 2 -
在我们离开奔宁汉姆酒店之前，岳河清给我看了一本小册子，他说这是要分发的。那是一张5.6英寸 x 4英寸的纸，上面用铅笔写着反日性质的文字。
我听到屋内传来几声枪响，很快那些人就从屋里出来，喊着“OK！OK！”
就在这时，有人喊道“汽车，汽车”，我们便登上了等候我们的汽车。如果我没记错的话，有五个人上了车。
我们在霞飞路下车，随后我住进了东昌酒店。在第二天的报纸上，我得知我们的受害者是维新政府外交部长陈箓（Cheng Loh）。
几天后，徐国琦通知我，我们在上海处境危险，建议我逃往香港，并给了我80.00美元作为路费。1941年3月左右，我乘坐英国轮船“何松”轮（S.S. Ho Sung）前往香港。出发前，我按照指示，住在码头旁一条不知名道路上的泰来酒店（Tai Lai Hotel）。第二天，徐国琦到那里看望了我。抵达香港两天后，我参加了戴笠（Ton Lin）在南京路金龙餐厅（Kin Loong Restaurant）举办的晚宴。出席晚宴的有程伯清（Yue Yih）、徐国琦（Zee Kah）、尤品山（Yue Ping San）、Tan Sun Yue、Dan Jao Nyi、平福昌（Ping Foo Chang）和

pages.en:
- 6 -

Tan Lih with two of his entourage.

The Chinese dinner started about 2 p.m., but
nothing regarding our work was discussed. Tan Lih made
each of us present of a fountain pen valued at about
$30.00 as souvenir. The fountain pen given to me was
left in the hotel at the time of my arrest.

On that occasion I saw Tan Yih for the first time.
He is an influential figure among the Military Committee
circles and seems to be always staying in Hongkong. I
do not know his address distinctly nor know I whether or
not he will come to Shanghai. He is aged about 37 or 38,
medium build, medium height, native of Chekiang and has
no particular features.

Re assassination of Tsun Tseng Ming (汤仲鸣) occurred in
French Concession.

I am ignorant of the details of the case, but
during my stay in Hongkong I heard that assassination was
committed by our followers with Wong Loo Yau (王魯堯) as
ringleader, under the direction of Tan Lih. This Wong
Loo Yau is the very man who have recently come to Shanghai
taking upon himself the work of an assassination of Wong
Ching Wei.

Question.
Have you acquaintance of the assailants of Tsun Tseng Ming,
namely Yue Poh Chuen (袁伯勳), Yang Wei Ho (楊維何)
and Sung Yah Fung (宋亞風)?

Answer. I do not know such persons.
pages.zh:
- 6 -

戴笠及其两名随从。

中式晚宴大约在下午2点开始，但没有讨论任何关于我们工作的事宜。戴笠送给在场每人一支价值约30.00美元的钢笔作为纪念。给我的那支钢笔在我被捕时留在了酒店里。

在那次场合，我第一次见到戴笠（Tan Yih）。他是军事委员会圈子中的有影响力人物，似乎一直住在香港。我不清楚他的确切地址，也不知道他是否会来上海。他大约37或38岁，中等身材，中等身高，浙江人，没有特别的面部特征。

关于发生在法租界的汤仲鸣（Tsun Tseng Ming）刺杀案。

我不了解该案细节，但在香港逗留期间，我听说那次刺杀是由我们的追随者在戴笠的指挥下实施的，由王鲁尧（Wong Loo Yau）带头。这个王鲁尧就是最近来到上海、承担刺杀汪精卫（Wong Ching Wei）任务的那个人。

问：
你认识汤仲鸣的袭击者吗，即袁伯勋（Yue Poh Chuen）、杨维何（Yang Wei Ho）和宋亚风（Sung Yah Fung）？

答：我不认识这些人。

pages.en:
- 2 -
Re my arrival in Shanghai for the purpose of assassinating
Wong Ching Wei.

After staying in Hongkong for about 3 months, Ping
Foo Chang, Tsu San Yue and I came to Shanghai on June 1,
aboard a steam ship (name unknown) for the purpose of
assassinating Wong Ching Wei. Besides we four men, those
assigned with this assassination were Hsu Wan Li (      ),
Yong Loo Yu and others. They came to Shanghai closely one
after the other. Yong Loo Yu hid in the Dun Peng Hotel and
Dah Chun Hotel but I do not know the hiding places of Hsu Wan Li.
We put up at the Yah Chin Hotel and later Ya Pao Lodging House
wherein we were arrested on June 29th. I did not undertake
any work since my arrival in Shanghai on the last occasion,
for I am to act on instructions.

Q. Was your work for the sake of your country or for your
own living?
A. It was in the service of my country.
Q. What is your idea regarding the Sino-Japanese relation
in future?
A. It is a most deplorable aspect that China and Japan should
be engaged in a struggle. As a result of the war, only foreign
countries will be able to fish in the troubled water. But
I am confident that peace will be restored sooner or later.
I am not affected by any doctrine or principle.

Sd: Don Pao Yee.
pages.zh:
- 2 -
关于我为刺杀汪精卫而抵达上海一事。

在香港逗留约三个月后，平福昌、朱三样和我于6月1日乘一艘轮船（船名不详）抵达上海，目的是刺杀汪精卫。除了我们四人，被指派执行此次刺杀任务的还有徐万里（Hsu Wan Li）、王鲁尧（Yong Loo Yu，音译对应前文Wong Loo Yau）等人。他们陆续来到上海。王鲁尧躲在敦朋酒店（Dun Peng Hotel）和大春酒店（Dah Chun Hotel），但我不知道徐万里的藏身之处。我们住在雅金酒店（Yah Chin Hotel），后来搬到雅宝旅馆（Ya Pao Lodging House），并于6月29日在那里被捕。自上次抵达上海以来，我没有从事任何工作，因为我需要等待指令行动。

问：你的工作是为了国家还是为了自己的生计？
答：是为国家服务。
问：你对未来中日关系有何看法？
答：中日陷入争斗是最令人痛心的局面。战争的结果只能是让外国坐收渔利。但我相信和平迟早会恢复。我不受任何主义或原则的影响。

签名：Don Pao Yee。

pages.en:
Dan Pao Yee (譚保義)

The above person made the following further state-
ment at the Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters on October 31,
1939.
Question : How matters stand at present regarding the
activities in Shanghai of the elements of
of Tai Lih's (戴笠) party.
Answer: As I mentioned on the previous questioning murder
of Cheng Loh took place on February 19th. this
year. I came to Shanghai only at the beginning
of February so I did not know about the movements
of our kindred spirits. On the last occasion, I
came to Shanghai towards the beginning of June
together with Ping Foo Chang (平福昌), Yue
Ping San (尤品山), Ts San Yue (朱山猿)
while I was arrested on the 29th. same month,
so I do not know regarding our followers'
situation. About 5 or 6 days before our arrival
here Wong Loo Jao (王魯), person in charge
of our group and Mao Van Lee (毛万里), who
was directing Wong Loo Jao reached Shanghai
from Hongkong. Wong Loo Jao was then staying
in Dah Fung (大方) and Dah Chung (大中)
Hotels, but I do not know how he is now. Wong
Loo Jao speaks northern dialect, age 35 or
thereabouts, 5'5" high, medium build, having
no particular feature. I have no acquaintance
of Wong Loo Jao, but Ping Foo Chang told these
to me. At first, the purpose which we came
pages.zh:
谭保义 (Dan Pao Yee)

上述人员于1939年10月31日在日本宪兵队总部作了如下进一步陈述。
问：戴笠 (Tai Lih) 一派分子在上海的活动目前情况如何。
答：正如我在上次审讯中所述，程洛 (Cheng Loh) 被杀案发生于今年2月19日。我直到2月初才来到上海，因此我不了解我们同志的行动。上一次，我于6月初与平福昌 (Ping Foo Chang)、尤品山 (Yue Ping San)、朱山猿 (Ts San Yue) 一同来到上海，而在同月29日我被捕，因此我不了解我们追随者的情况。在我们抵达此处前约五六天，我们要组的负责人王鲁 (Wong Loo Jao) 以及指导王鲁的毛万里 (Mao Van Lee) 从香港抵达上海。王鲁当时住在大方 (Dah Fung) 和大中 (Dah Chung) 旅馆，但我不知道他现在的下落。王鲁讲北方方言，年龄约35岁，身高5英尺5英寸，中等身材，无显著特征。我与王鲁并不相识，这些情况是平福昌告诉我的。起初，我们来

pages.en:
(2)

to Shanghai for was not clearly known to me, but one
day Ping Foo Chang told me that we are assigned with
the work of assassination of Wang Ching Wei. At the
time of our arrest, Yue Ping San and Ts San Yun were
staying at the Dah Zung (大成) Lodging House, Rue
Auguste Boppe, French Concession. I do not know how
they are at present. Yue Ping San has a good control
of Shanghai dialect, age 25 or 26, 5'3" high, with
no features. Ts San Yue speaks Shanghai dialect
aged 27 or 28, medium build, no features. Yue Foo
Ching (游河清), Lee Kwok Gee (徐國琦) and Lieu Hai
San (刘海山) are believed to be staying in Hongkong.
Our position at the time of arrest were direct
members and person 1/6 of our group was Wong Loo
Jao. I have no knowledge of the location, personnel
etc. of the local organ of Tai Lih's party.

Question: What sort of a man, Tai Lih is?
Answer: He is prominent among the Military Committee (posi-
tion unknown) and is always staying in Hongkong, but
I know little about him.

Question: How is Tai Lih keeping in touch with his organ in
Shanghai?
Answer: I have no knowledge of it.

Question: Is Dan Pao Zen connected with your group?
Answer: No, he has nothing to do with it. But he knows that
I am an assailant of Cheng Loh. After my arrival
here from Hongkong on the last occasion I have often
visited him at No.436 Rue Fralupt, French Concession,
pages.zh:
(2)

上海的目的我并不清楚，但有一天平福昌告诉我，我们被指派执行刺杀汪精卫的任务。在我们被捕时，尤品山和朱山云 (Ts San Yun) 住在法租界奥古斯特·博佩路 (Rue Auguste Boppe) 的大成 (Dah Zung) 旅舍。我不知道他们目前的状况。尤品山精通上海话，年龄25或26岁，身高5英尺3英寸，无显著特征。朱山猿 (Ts San Yue) 讲上海话，年龄27或28岁，中等身材，无显著特征。游河清 (Yue Foo Ching)、徐国琦 (Lee Kwok Gee) 和刘海山 (Lieu Hai San) 据信住在香港。我们在被捕时的身份是直接成员，而我们小组的负责人是王鲁。我对戴笠一派在上海的地方机构的地点、人员等情况一无所知。

问：戴笠是什么样的人？
答：他在军事委员会（职位不详）中地位显赫，常驻香港，但我对他知之甚少。

问：戴笠如何与其在上海的机构保持联系？
答：我对此一无所知。

问：谭宝珍 (Dan Pao Zen) 是否与你们小组有关联？
答：不，他与此毫无关系。但他知道我是刺杀程洛的凶手。上一次我从香港抵达此处后，我经常在法租界法拉普路 (Rue Fralupt) 436号拜访他，

pages.en:
(3)

where he is jointly dealing in corn with Tsau
is Ning (周子敏). Once he asked me, "I learned
that you have been to Hongkong, but you have
returned here again now, and what for?" I replied,
"To tell the truth, I killed Cheng Loh some time
ago, and now on instructions I am again here in
Shanghai." "There is no need to worry about
what you have done but it would be better not
to be further involved ", advised he.

Question: Was Ping Foo Chang an acquaintance of Dan Pau Zen?
Answer: When Dan Pau Zen called at the Ya Foo Lodging
House I introduced Ping Foo Chang to him as a
school-mate. Dan Pau Zen knows that Ping Foo
Chang is also responsible for the assassination
of Cheng Loh, for after our arrest by the S.M.Poli
ce Dan Pau Zen asked me if Ping Foo Chang was
also in conspiracy in the assassination, to which
I replied in affirmative.

Question: Is Special Section of the Military Committee
still existent? What is its substance?

Answer: It is illustrated as follows:
Yue Loh Sing(余樂醒) (1.Intelligence..100m
1/s S.S.M.C.---1st.Battalion-(2.Executive...100 me
(--2nd. " Military Affairs..200 m
(--3rd. " Female Corps.....Scores

1. Enrollment is allowed through strict examination
2. Recruit must be under 30 years of age.
3. Graduates will be detailed to every part of the
country (including Japanese occupied areas).
pages.zh:
(3)

他在那里与周子敏 (Tsau is Ning) 共同经营粮食生意。有一次他问我：“听说你去了香港，但现在又回到这里，是为了什么？”我回答说：“实话实说，我前段时间杀了程洛，现在奉命再次来到上海。”他建议道：“你做过的事不必担心，但最好不要再进一步卷入。”

问：平福昌是谭宝珍 (Dan Pau Zen) 的熟人吗？
答：当谭宝珍到访亚富 (Ya Foo) 旅舍时，我将平福昌作为同学介绍给他。谭宝珍知道平福昌也负责刺杀程洛，因为在我们被工部局警务处 (S.M.Police) 逮捕后，谭宝珍问我平福昌是否也参与了刺杀阴谋，我给予了肯定的答复。

Question. Are there not any graduates of this institute who
have approached the Reformed Government circles
by ostensibly representing themselves as pro-
Japanese figures?

Answer: I believe there may be some, but not any acquaint-
ances of mine.

Question: Were not various terroristic outrages, arsons and
other violences in Shanghai committed by your
followers.

Answer: As we have no lateral connection, I do not know

问：该机构是否有毕业生伪装成亲日人物，从而接近维新政府圈子？

答：我相信可能有这样的人，但没有我的熟人。

问：上海发生的各种恐怖暴行、纵火和其他暴力行为是否由你们的追随者所为？

答：由于我们没有横向联系，我对这些罪行一无所知。

问：关于本案你还有其它要陈述的吗？

答：恳请宽大处理。

(签名) 谭保义。

pages.en:
Dan Pao Yee (譚保毅)

The above person made the following further
statement at the Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters on
October 25, 1939.

Q. Are you sure that the number of the pistols brought
to the scene of assassination was four (4)? How is
it that Ping Foo Chang states that they were five (5)
instead of four (4)?

A. I remember they were four, but they might be five, I
wonder.

Q. When did you learn that the victim was Cheng Loh(陳籙)?
Your previous statement is vague on this point.

A. When all of us met at the Chang Chow Hotel at about
4 p.m. on that day, I asked Yue Ho Zing(岳河情)
whom we were going to kill. He replied it was Cheng
(  ), high official in Nanking. As I stated on the
previous questioning it was not until I saw the following
day's paper that I learned that our victim had been
Cheng Loh(陳籙), Minister of Foreign Affairs.

sd/ Dan Pao Yee.
pages.zh:
谭保毅 (Dan Pao Yee)

上述人员于1939年10月25日在日本宪兵队总部作了如下进一步陈述。

问：你确定带到刺杀现场的手枪数量是四 (4) 支吗？为何平福昌声称是五 (5) 支而不是四 (4) 支？

答：我记得是四支，但也可能是五支，我不确定。

问：你何时得知受害者是陈箓 (Cheng Loh)？你之前的陈述在此点上含糊不清。

答：当天下午4点左右，当我们都在常州旅馆 (Chang Chow Hotel) 聚会时，我问岳河情 (Yue Ho Zing) 我们要杀谁。他回答说是南京的一位高官陈 ( )。正如我在上次审讯中所述，直到第二天看到报纸，我才知道我们的受害者是外交部长陈箓 (Cheng Loh)。

签名/ 谭保义。

Dan Pau Zung ( 〔此处转录不清〕 ) , age 30, Chinese
Junking // 2nd Sub-Lieutenant K. todo
Japanese Gen.H.Q. 25.10.39

The above person made the following statement at
the Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters on Oct. 25, 1939.
My name is Dan Pau Zung alias Dan Pao Ding, age
30, native of S-Kin Village, Sunkiang Hsien, Kiangsu,
corn-chandler, residing at No. 426 Route Frelupt, F.C.
I am an elder brother of Dan Pau Yee.
In order to make this case clear, I shall state
the movements of Dan Pau Yee.
Some time in March this year, when I was smoking
opium at Room 302, Cham Nam Hotel, Dan Pau Yee visited
on me there. In those days he looked nervous and when
I asked him to be open with me he confided that he together
with his conspirators had murdered Cheng Loh, Minister of
Foreign Affairs.
Since that time he failed to come to see me, and
I was anxious about him.
Towards the middle of June, he unexpectedly called
at me and stated that he, in accordance with instructions,
had come to Shanghai again.
After his return to Shanghai from Hongkong, he
introduced Ping Foo Chang to me as a school-mate. Later
in the previous evening of our arrest, 28.6.39, he again
introduced to me Ping Foo Chang as a school-mate. At
that time I did not know that Ping Foo Chang was a conspirator
of an assassination of Cheng Loh.
Whilst held in the custody of the S.M.Police I
asked Dan Pau Yee if Ping Foo Chang was also an assistant of
pages.zh:
谭宝宗 (Dan Pau Zung) (〔此处转录不清〕)，30岁，中国人
 Junking // 二等少尉 K. todo
日本宪兵队总部 1939年10月25日

上述人员于1939年10月25日在日本宪兵队总部作了如下陈述。
我叫谭宝宗，别名谭宝鼎 (Dan Pao Ding)，30岁，籍贯江苏松江县新泾村 (S-Kin Village, Sunkiang Hsien, Kiangsu)，粮商，居住在法租界法拉普路 (Route Frelupt) 426号。
我是谭保义的兄长。
为了澄清此案，我将陈述谭保义的行踪。
今年3月的某个时候，当我在新南酒店 (Cham Nam Hotel) 302房吸食鸦片时，谭保义来那里看望我。那些日子他看起来很紧张，当我让他对我坦诚相告时，他透露他与同谋者一起谋杀了外交部长陈箓。
从那以后他没再来看我，我很为他担心。
6月中旬，他突然来访，称他奉命再次来到上海。
他从香港回到上海后，将平福昌作为同学介绍给我。后来在我们被捕的前一晚，即1939年6月28日，他再次将平福昌作为同学介绍给我。当时我不知道平福昌是刺杀陈箓的同谋。
在被工部局警务处 (S.M.Police) 拘留期间，我问谭保义，平福昌是否也是

Ting Foo Chang has no such alias as Wong Yet Ping (王亞彬).
Question : According to your previous statement you were
informed by Dan Pau Yee, prior to his departure for Hongkong
that he (Dan Pau Yee) was responsible for the assassination
of Cheng Leh.
Was this not your mistake and was not the case
that you were informed of it after his return from Hongkong.
A. It was my mistake, it was told to me after his
return from Hongkong.
Q. Have you anything else to state regarding this case?
A. No.

丁福昌 (Ting Foo Chang) 没有王亚彬 (Wong Yet Ping) 这个别名。
问：根据你之前的陈述，在谭保义前往香港之前，他告诉你他 (谭保义) 对刺杀陈勒 (Cheng Leh) 负责。
这难道不是你的错误吗？事实难道不是在他从香港回来后你才得知的吗？
答：这是我的错误，是在他从香港回来后告诉我的。
